tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal kyai rdo rje'i man ngag lugs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub pa'i cho ga ngag 'don gyi rim pa bzhugs so/ /dge'o// na mo gu ru dha ra he badz+ra ye/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang kyai rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtsa brgyud bla mar gus btud nas/ /dges pa rdo rje'i phyi nang gi /mngon rtogs dkyil 'khor cho gar bcas/ /mdzes rgyan dgongs pa phyogs gcig spel/ /de la 'dir/ rjes bzung bsnyen pa sa chog dang / /sta gon bri rgyan sgrub cing mchod/ /'jug cing dbang blang mjug chog ste/ /spyi bsdom brgyad las dang po gsum/ /gzhan du shes bya sta gon la/ /sbyor dngos rjes kyi dang po ni/ gang du dkyil 'khor bya ba'i sar/ /thig chen brgyad dam dkyil 'khor gyi/ /skya thig rdzogs par btab pa'i dbus/ /dri yi thig le gru bzhi dang / phyag len la de'i mdun du dri yi thig le zlum po'i steng du yum gyi tshom bu bgod/ phyogs mtshams rnams su zlum po'i steng / /me tog tshom bu re re dgod/ /de yi dbus su mañji la/ /sogs pa'i steng du sa lha yi/ /maṇ+ḍal tshom bu legs par bshams/ /ras bris ltar na lha dgu yi/ /tshom bu'ang maṇ+ḍal la bkod de/ /sa lha 'og dang lha dgu yi/ /maṇ+ḍal steng du bshams na mdzes/ phyag len la ras bris dang rdul tshon gang ltar yang / lha dgu'i tshom bu dbus dang / sa lha'i tshom bu byang du bshams par mdzad/ de yi phyi rol byang shar gyi/ /mtshams su mtshams 'dzin me tog dang / /shar du zhabs bsil zhal bsil gnyis/ /shar lhor 'thor dung lhor mchod yon/ /lho nub mtshams su me tog dang / /nub tu bdug spos mar me gnyis/ /nub byang dri chab byang zhal zas/ /de rnams gru bzhir bshams nang du/ /shar nub gnyis su lhag re dang / /bcas pa'i phyogs bzhir mtshams bzhi ru/ /bdug spos mar me zhal zas re/ /g.yas bskor dag tu gru bzhir bsham/ /sa lha'i maṇ+ḍal nye logs su/

/gtor ma gcig bsham 'byor gyur na/ /sgos mchod kyang bsham dkyil 'khor gyi/ /byang shar nas brtsams shar lho'i bar/ /'das pa'i lha dang 'jig rten pa'i/ /gtor ma gnyis sam lnga la sogs/ /gang dgos bsham zhing logs shig tu/ /sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma dang / /grub na las kun sa'i mchod pa/ /me tog la sogs rnam lnga yang / /bshams na legs par bdag gis mthong / /slob dpon mdun du rdor dril dang / /nang mchod gos zung la sogs bsham/ /mtshan ldan bum pa gnyis sam bcu/ /legs bkrus kha tshar ma nyams pa'i/ /ras bzang mgul 'ching prog lnga pa'i/ /bdun pa legs bcing lha so so'i/ /g.yas kyi phyag mtshan bris la gdags/ /gnyis las med na rnam rgyal la/ /pad+mar gnas pa'i thod pa ni/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa dang / /gri gug legs gdags las bum la/ /sna tshogs rdo rje bris te gdags/ /'khyil pa bzla zhing gu gul gyis/ /legs bdug yungs kar dag gis brab/ /gtsang ma'i chu yis gsum gnyis dgang / /nas gro sran 'bras til 'bru lnga/ /gser dngul byu ru mu tig dang / /mu man zhes bya rin chen lnga/ /sle tre kaṇ+ḍa shu dag dkar/ /rgya mtsho lbu ba dbang lag sman/ /lan tshwa bu ram 'o ma dang / /mar dang sbrang rtsi snying po lnga/ /tsan dan dkar dmar gur gum dang / /ga pur dza ti dri bzang lnga/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam lnga ste/ /sum cu rtsa lnga ci 'byor zhugs/ /ku sha'i kha rgyan bum gdan steng / /lha yi bkod pa ji bzhin bsham/ /las bum puk+ka si'i g.yas gzhag /gnyis las med na rnam rgyal g.yas/ /las bum g.yon gzhag ldog pa'ang yod/ /rnam rgyal steng du dung chos sogs/ /dri bzang chu yis bkang ba dang / /gzungs thag btags pa'i rdo rje gzhag /slob ma sta gon bya dgos na/ /nyer spyod so shing khyor chu dang / /dpung skud ku sha sogs bsham mo/ /zhes ji skad bshad pa de dag ni dbang gi chu bo chen mo'i dgongs pa tho tsam zhig bkod pa ste/

zhib tu brgyud pa'i phyag len mthong ba las shes so/ /dngos gzhi bdag bskyed bzlas mchod rjes/ /dkyil 'khor bsdus nas sa lha dang / /lha dang bum pa slob ma rnams/ /lhag par gnas pa rim bzhin bya/ /zhes te de yang rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ sngon 'gro gtor ma la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor la/ a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs te/ 'og tu bsang sbyangs zhes 'byung ba rnams su'ang 'di dran par bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma la lag pa g.yon pa bstan te oṃ/ g.yas pa bstan te āḥ gnyis ka bstan te hūm̐/ lag pa gnyis ni bkan byas la/ /srin lag gnyis ni phan tshun dkri/ /gung mo dang ni mtheb rtse sbyar/ /khro bo gnyis kyis mnan par bya/ /zhes pa ltar bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan te hoḥzhes dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hriḥ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo gnyis bkug la/ oṃ mahā bhū ta sa pa ri wā ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes pas gtor mgron spyan drangs/ pad bskor dang bcas pa'i rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ in+d+ra dza ma zhes sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ mahā bhū ta sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'byung po brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /zhes dang g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod phul/ rdo rje nu ma g.yas steng bzung / /dril bu snying kha'i thad du bkrol/ /lag pa nu ma'i steng du bsgyings/ /sgra ni sku gsung thugs su sgrogs/ /zhes pa ltar dril bu gsum brdung byas la/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod/ /mi bskyod rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ /rdo rje snying kha dang dril bu chig brdung byas la/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /zhes sogs kyi rjes su/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du/

phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub snying po kyai rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i ched du sa'i phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te sgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'tshal na/ zhes pa tsam mam/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba 'tshal na/ zhes pa skabs dang sbyar la/ srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams kyis dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du/ bar du gcod pa thams cad srung ba dang / /deng nas kyang byang chub ma thob kyi bar gyi bar chad thams cad srung ba dang gtong grogs mdzod cig muḥzhes brjod de/ lag pa g.yas pa sa la reg pas gtor mgron rnams sgrub khang gi phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams rnams su gshegs par bsam zhing / gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can de dag thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces dang / aṣ+ṭa bzla zhing rdo rje sor/ dril bu drag tu dkrol la/ gtor mgron gyi phyi 'brang gi bgegs rnams ring du bskrad par bsams te/ gtor ma gtsang sar bskyal lo/ de nas gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+ruṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis mdzes shing / rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du mchod rdzas rnams a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung / mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las grub pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing gtsang ba/ yul nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab pa/

dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stong gi bar rgyun mi chad par gyur/ zhes dang / so so'i phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ nī ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi ti hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ sarba saṃ shwa dha ni swāhā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ mahā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' gnyis 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar te/ dhuṣ+pe/ ā lo ke gan+de/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+da'i bar dang / mthar rdo rje snying khar bzung / dril bu rgyun dkrol dang / rol mo ji snyed pa 'bud dkrol byas te/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe ṭa/ pra tsa li te/ pra dz+nyā pa ra mi ta/ nā da saṃ bhā we/ badz+ra dharma hrīḥd ya ni/ san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod de/ gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad rnams sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis kyang byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo/ /mchod pa rnams kyi phyag rgya ni/ /khu tshur kha sbyar gung mo gnyis/ /brkyangs te rtse sbyar chu bzhi'i rgya/ /khu tshur gyen 'thor me tog gi /thur du blug pa bdug pa'i 'o/ /mthe bong gyen bsgreng mar me'i ste/ /thal mo phyir bstan dri mchog gi /de nyid gyen bkan zhal zas so/ /se gol gtogs pa rol mo'i sgra/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de nas tshogs pa che zhing slob dpon du 'os pa yod pa dang / zhu 'bul byed par spro na/ las kyi slob mas thun mong du phyag gsum byas la/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun pa phul te/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun rnams la/ rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin zab mo la gnas par zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes sogs brjod de/ phyag gsum byas la slob dpon gyi mdun du me tog gis bkang ba'i snod spos reng dang bcas pa dang / gzhan rnams la so sor me tog re phul/

phyag gsum byas la 'greng ste 'dud pa dang bcas pa'am/ pus mo sa la btsugs la me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te/ kun bzang rnam 'phrul mchod pa'i sprin phung gis/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams mchod pa dang / /yon bdag bgegs zhi tshogs gnyis rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /gnyis med ting 'dzin dag la gnas par mdzod/ /ces lan gsum brjod cing / re re'i mthar me tog re gtor la/ phyag gsum byas la slob dpon ma gtogs gzhan rnams las me tog re bsdu/ phyag gsum byas la/ thams cad kyis thun mong du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ zhes bskul te tshogs pa thams cad kyis bla ma la tshogs kyi rdo rje slob dpon zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas tshom bu dang bcas pa slob dpon gyi drung du gzhag slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi tshom bu de nyid kyi steng du slar yang me tog bsnan la maṇ+ḍal phul te/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes sogs brjod/ las kyi slob mas maṇ+ḍal rten gyi drung du sogs gang rigs su bzhag ste/ phyag gsum byas la rang nyid gral la 'dug go /de dag gi sdoms ni/ phyag sum btsal la maṇ+ḍal dbul/ /phyag gsum btsal la me tog dkram/ /phyag gsum btsal la zhu 'bul bya/ /phyag gsum btsal la me tog bsdu/ /phyag gsum btsal la maṇ+ḍal bskul/ /phyag gsum btsal la gral la 'dug /ces pa ltar ro/ /de nas skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te rdzogs rim gyi rjes su dag pa dran pa dang bzlas pa bya ba'i bar bdag bskyed yan lag drug pa bzhin rdzogs par bsgom par bya ste/ de yang thog mar skyabs yul rnams mngon sum lta bur dmigs te bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/

'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes ci nus kyi mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi brgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsams/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gi lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang 'dra'i rigs bdag gi dbu rgyan can/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po/ de las 'od 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drang nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas hūm̐ las bdud rtsi bab yab kyi sku gang / dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi sku gang / yab yum gyi sku thams cad las bdud rtsi bab/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon nas shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/

oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ rdo rje khrag 'thung dam tshig gi rjes su skyong / he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ khrag 'thung nyid kyis nye bar gnas par mdzod/ ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ bdag la brtan par mdzad du gsol/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ bdag la shin tu dges par mdzod/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ bdag la rjes su chags par mdzod/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ bdag la shin tu rgyas par mdzod/ sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha/ bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsol/ sarba karma su tsa me/ las kun la'ang bdag ni/ tsit+ta shrī yaṃḥku ru hūm̐/ sems la dge legs su ni mdzod/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wān badz+ra he ru ka bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khrag thung du/ mā me muñca he ru ko bha wa/ bdag grol khrag 'thung nyid du mdzod/ mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭ/ dam tshig sems dpa' chen po āḥ /ces ci nus kyi mthar/ bla ma bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig la ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa dang ltung ba/ dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu ste/ spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur/ rang skad cig gis dpal kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sems gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba'i ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas gtso bos dbu la brgyan pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥshrī he badz+ra maṇ+ḍa le sa pa ri wa re bh+yaḥ snying kha'i hūm̐ las spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams te/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing / /puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bor mchod/ /'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /ces pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni bsdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung / /rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la/

/rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung / /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /ces lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces brjod/ chos thams cad rang gi sems kyi snang bas/ de yang rang rig pa sgyu ma lta bu/ de yang rang bzhin gyi mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du shes par byas la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ 'khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas gang bar gyur/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar paṃ las pad+ma dang /

raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du bh+rum̐ ser po las/ 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa/ /rtse mo rno ba/ khog pa stong pa yangs shing rgya che ba go skabs med par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ bh+rum̐ hūm̐/ lan gsum/ 'khor lo'i nang gi dbus dang phyogs bcur pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus kyi nyi ma'i steng du bh+rum̐ ser po/ phyogs bcur nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ de yang lho'i dkar po/ nub kyi dmar po/ gzhan thams cad sngon po/ de thams cad so so'i gnas su yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ shar du gshin rje gshed sngon po tho ba 'dzin pa/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed sngon po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ byang shar du mi g.yo ba sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu dbyug sngon can sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du stobs po che sngon po rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ steng du hūm̐ mdzad sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu rang gi phyag rgyas thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes sngon po gtun shing 'dzin pa/ hūm̐ mdzad ma yin pa gzhan thams cad/ phyag g.yas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dbus dang phyogs bzhi'i khro bo rnams ni brjid pa'i khro bo ste/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing bgrad pa/ sku sbom zhing thung ba/ gsus khyim che ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ sma ra dang / smin ma dang / dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ khro bo gzhan rnams ni mdzes pa'i khro bo ste/ cung zad sgeg cing yid tsam khros pa/ sku skem zhing grim pa/

dbu skra nag po/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ thams cad kyang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas khro bo bcu gcig srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa la ye shes kyi khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod/ gau rī sogs sngags rgyas bstim/ slar yang rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dkar mo rig dwags sogs kyis mchod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyi/ /khyod kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yis/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /'og ma rnams la'ang 'di'i rig pas shes/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chu'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gshin rje gshed la rnam par snang mdzad/ pad+ma mthar byed la 'od dpag med/ gzhan thams cad la mi bskyod pa re res dbur brgyan/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ba spu'i bu ga thams cad rdo rje phra mo dpag tu med pas bltams par bsam/ hūm̐ de nyid rdo rje sngon po gyen du langs pa zhig tu gyur te/ de'i lte ba stong par yod pa'i nang du rang gi sems hūm̐ gcig tu bsam/

de'i steng la sogs pa gang bsrung bar 'dod pa de'i ming gi yi ge dang po bsams te/ de'ang bla ma bsrung bar 'dod na steng du/ rang nyid nang du/ spun zla g.yon du/ pha ma mdun du/ bu dang chung ma g.yas su/ g.yog 'khor rgyab tu/ nor rdzas rnams 'og tu bsam/ gang mi bsrung ba'i sa stong par bzhag go /de nas 'khor lo'i phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi rtsibs med pa'i bar du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ gnod byed lus rid pa/ skra 'dzings pa/ kha nas khrag skyug pa/ spyi bo tshugs su 'dug par bsam/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas gnod byed kyi ye shes pa bkug ste/ de la thim par bsam la/ rang gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur bas hūm̐ zhes brjod pas phyogs mtshams kyi khro bo rnams zhal phyir gzigs/ dbus dang steng gi khro bo rnams zhabs g.yas brkyang / 'khor lo g.yon du myur du 'khor bas/ gnod byed kyi lus rlung gis bskyod/ mes bsreg cing 'khor lo'i rtse mos gtubs pas/ khos tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs nas/ rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyes par bsam zhing sngags bzla'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ phyag 'tshal lo kun nas sangs rgyas la/ na maḥs man+ta dharmā naṃ/ phyag 'tshal lo kun nas chos la/ na maḥs man+ta saṃ ghā naṃ/ phyag 'tshal lo kun nas dge 'dun la/ oṃ si tā ta pa tra/ gdugs dkar po/ oṃ bi ma la dri ma dang bral ba/ oṃ shaṃ ka ra/ bde bar byed pa/ oṃ pra t+yaṃ gi ra/ phyir bzlog pa/ badz+ra uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra warti/ rdo rje gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur pa/ sarba yan+t+ra/ thams cad 'phrul 'khor/ man+t+ra/ sngags/ mū la karma/ rtsa ba'i las/ ban+dha naṃ/ bcing ba dang / tā ḍa ṇaṃ/ bsngags pa dang / kī la nāṃ wā/ phur bus btab kyang rung /

ma ma kri te/ bdag la byed pa dang / ye na ke na/ gang ci yang rung ba/ tsi ta kri tan+ta te/ sems par byed pa/ sarbān+tu/ de thams cad/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da/ chod chod/ bhin+da bhin+da/ phug phug tsi ri tsi ri/ phye mar gyis phye mar gyis/ gi ri gi ri/ gnon gnon/ ma ra ma ra/ gsod gsod/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ ces ci nus dang / spro na/ oṃ bha ya nā sa ni/ 'jigs pa nyams par byed/ tā sa ni/ skrag par byed/ sarba mā ra/ bdud thams cad/ pra t+yaṃ gi ra/ phyir bzlog par byed pa/ bi nā sa ni/ rnam par nyams par byed/ ye ge tsi taṃ/ gang ci yang rung ba/ duṣ+ṭa na satwa/ gdug pa'i sems can thams cad/ satwa ma ma bi ru pa kaṃ bdag la ngan par byed pa/ kur+wan/ ti tā naṃ/ de dag dang / sarba ma ra ṇi/ bdud thams cad/ pra t+yaṃ ka ri ṇi pa ta tu/ phyir bzlog par gyis shig hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ legs par byin/ zhes pa'ang ci rigs bzlas la/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar te/ su gang dag bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / bdag cag la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shugs kyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / bsam pa dang sbyor ba ngan par byed pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig gal te zhi bar ma gyur na/ de'i tshe de dag thams cad kyi lus bcing bar bgyi'o/ /ngag bcing bar bgyi'o/ /yid bcing bar bgyi'o/ /mthu brlag par gyur cig rdzu 'phrul brlag par gyur cig stobs brlag par gyur cig des bzlas pa'i sngags kyis de nyid brlag par gyur cig des bsgrubs pa'i lha 'dres de nyid kyi sha za bar gyur cig ces brjod/ lag mthil gnyis su hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje dang / sor mo rnams rdo rje rtse gcig par bsams te/

gnod byed rnams de'i bar du btsir bar bsams la/ thal mo brdab/ rang gi thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i khro bo tshon cha thogs pa du ma spros te gnod byed kyi lus dang dbang po thams cad rdul phra rab tu byas/ mes bsregs/ rlung gis gtor bar bsam/ spro na/ khro bo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /lus ngag thal ba rdul du rlogs/ /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ dbus su rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba zhu ba las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ gdengs ka che ba gyen du bstan pa/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ de'i nang du yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs pa lta bu/ chang bzung dang mchog ma la yam̐ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du wam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po zur bzhir rdo rje phyed pa dang lte ba la lam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bh+rum̐ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa bh+rum̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng gi bar snang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥdamar po gnyis kyis mtha' brten pa'i bar do'i rnam par shes pa de rnams 'byung bzhi 'khor lo dang bcas pa la thim ste thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin nag po/ ljang khu/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ slob dpon rin po che'i dgongs pa'o/ /rje btsun rin po che ltar na/ nang nas rim pa bzhin/ nag po/ dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ ljang khu sgom/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/

de'i steng du rin po che'i mda' yab dang pu shus brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mang ris su bres shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje dang rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ sgo bzhi'i thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du/ pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang ri dwags dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gos dang phan dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang / rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad ni/ shar du gtum drag gi dur khrod/ lhor 'jigs byed thod pa can/ nub tu 'bar ba'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ byang shar du drag tu dgod pa/ shar lhor dbang phyug nags tshal/ lho nub tu 'jigs byed mun pa/ nub byang du ki li ki li'i sgra sgrog pa/ de dag la gnas pa'i shing chen po brgyad ni/ shar du shi rī sha/ lhor tsu ta/ nub tu kaṃ ka la/ byang du a shwat+tha/ byang shar du shing chen po/ shar lhor ka rañja/ lho nub tu 'khri shing can/ nub byang du ardzun rnams so/ /shing de dag gi rtsa ba la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad ni/ shar du rgya byin ser po glang po che la zhon pa/ phyag g.yon rdo rjes mtshan pa'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa/ g.yon thod pa dang be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa/ g.yon thod pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon pa/ g.yon thod pa dang dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du dbang ldan dkar po glang la zhon pa/

g.yon thod pa dang mdung 'dzin pa/ shar lhor me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na dbyug gu dang thod pa/ g.yon gnyis na spyi blugs dang phreng ba 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu srin po nag po ro langs la zhon pa/ g.yon thod pa dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub byang du rlung lha sngon po ri dwags la zhon pa/ g.yon thod pa dang ba dan 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang phyag g.yas kyis bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /de dag gi nam mkha' la gnas pa'i sprin chen po brgyad ni/ shar du sgrogs byed ser po/ lhor ldog byed sngon po/ nub tu 'jigs byed dkar po/ byang du 'khor byed ser po/ byang shar du 'thug po dkar po/ shar lhor 'gengs byed dmar po/ lho nub tu char 'bebs sngon po/ nub byang du gtum po sngon po'o/ /de dag la gnas pa'i klu chen po brgyad ni/ shar du nor rgyas ser po/ lhor pad+ma dkar po/ nub tu karko ṭa nag po/ byang du 'jog po dmar po/ byang shar du pad+ma chen po dkar po/ shar lhor hu lun+ta sngon po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan ljang khu/ nub byang du dung skyong ser po/ thams cad kyang sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun bdun dang ldan zhing / smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba/ stod lha'i lus can thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /shing gi yal ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong ba brgyad ni/ shar du lha'i dge 'dun dkar po glang po che'i gdong pa can/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he'i gdong ba can/ nub tu sprin gyi rgyal po dmar po chu srin gyi gdong ba can/ byang du gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon ser po rta'i gdong pa can/ byang shar du yi dwags 'dus pa dud kha glang gi gdong pa can/ shar lhor drang srong 'dus pa dmar po ra skyes kyi gdong pa can/ lho nub tu srin po'i tshogs can nag po ro langs kyi gdong pa can/ nub byang du rlung gi rgyal po ljang khu ri dwags kyi gdong pa can/ thams cad kyang shing lo'i gseb nas snying kha yan chad 'thon pa/

gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /gzhan yang ro mgo bo bcad pa dang / dpyang ba dang / brnyal ba dang / gsal shing gis phug pa dang / mgo bo dang / rkang rus dang / ce spyang dang / khwa dang / 'ug pa dang / bya rgod dang / ro langs rnams phai ཾzhes bya ba'i sgra sgrog par byed pa/ ma lus pa rnams kyang sngon gyi grub pa thob pa rnams kyi mngon par rtogs pa ste/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / yi dwags dang / sha za dang / smyo byed dang / brjod byed dang / mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang / chu dang / me dang / mchod rten dang / sgrub pa po rnams dang bcas pa'i dur khrod kyis yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngon po'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du nyon mongs pa la sogs pa bdud bzhi'i ngo bo tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang sngon po/ drag po nag po rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ shar du tshangs pa ser po/ lhor dbang po dkar po/ nub tu nye dbang sngon po/ byang du drag po nag po/ byang shar du gshin rje sngon po/ shar lhor nor bdag ser po/ lho nub tu srin po nag po/ nub byang du thags zangs ris dud kha rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ni la ya badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo skar ma'i rnam pa lta bu'i/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ phrag gnyis brjod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du dpe byed bzang po brgyad cu'i bdag nyid mar me'i phreng ba lta bu'i/ ka kha ga gha nga /

tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ phrag gnyis brjod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral bar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de'i g.yon du am̐ las gri gug sngo nag gi yu ba la am̐ gis mtshan pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ nyi zla phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar po/ zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha/ zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis gnag pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha ser po/ de gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang ser po/ lnga pa na rnga mong thal ka drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na sha ra bha sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi la gwa pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu'i lha dkar po/ gsum pa na me'i lha dmar po/ bzhi pa na rlung gi lha ljang khu/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po/ bdun pa na gshin rje sngon po/ brgyad pa na nor 'dzin ser po/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan cing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyangs pa'i brla la/ g.yon gnyis bskum pa'i sor mo rnams gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/

sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /dgod cing drag shugs 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing / g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la āḥyis mtshan pa/ oṃ pad+ma su khā dha ra/ pad+ma bde bar 'dzin pa ni/ mahā rā ga su khan+dha da/ 'dod chags chen po'i bde ba ster/ tsa tu rā nan+da bha ga bi shwa/ dga' bzhi'i skal ba sna tshogs pa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kar+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ bya ba mdzod cig bdag la'o/ /yab kyi gsang ba'i gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ badz+ra mahā dwe ṣa/ rdo rje zhe sdang chen po ni/ tsa tu rā nan+da dā ya kaḥ dga' ba bzhi ni ster bar byed/ kha ga mu kha e kā ra so nā tha/ mkha' 'gro'i gdong pa ro gcig mgon/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kā r+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ bya ba mdzod cig bdag la'o/ /yab yum snyoms par bzhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgra ha ha si si kun du r+ha badz+ra dh+ri ka ces gsang ba'i gnas su grag pa'i sgras/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar bab pas thig le brgyad du gyur/ de rnams gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐ zhes pa'i sa bon brgyad du gyur/

de rnams 'od du zhu/ lha mo brgyad du gyur nas yum gyi mkha' nang nas phyir 'thon te/ gdan so so'i steng du rim pa bzhin 'khod pa ni/ shar du gau rī nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ lhor tsau rī dmar mo g.yas cang te'u/ g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu betā lī ser mo/ g.yas rus sbal/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du ghasma rī ljang khu g.yas sbrul/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du puk+ka sī sngo mo g.yas seṅge/ g.yon dgra satwa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor ri khrod ma dkar mo g.yas dge slong / g.yon gsil byed 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gdol pa ma sngo dmar g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thong shol 'dzin pa/ nub byang du g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ slar yang yab yum snyom par bzhugs pa'i bar snang nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥdamar po gnyis kyis mtha' brten pa'i bar do'i rnam par shes pa yab kyi zhal du bzhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar yi ge sleb pa'i rkyen gyi yab yum gnyis rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu nas bdud bzhi'i steng du bde ba chen po'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gyi thig ler gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rang gi shes pa mtshams kyi lha mo bzhir 'phos te glus bskul bar bsam zhing / rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhengs shig /puk+ka sī ni bdag la skyobs/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spong la/ /bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhed mdzod/ /khyod med na ni bdag 'gum pas/

/kye yi rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /ri khrod ma 'bras grub par mdzod/ /dga' gtso 'jig rten mgron gnyer ba/ /stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam ci/ /khyod med phyogs na mi 'tshal bas/ /gdol pa mo bdag zhu bar bgyid/ /bdag gis khyod kyi thugs 'tshal gyis/ /mig 'phrul mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig /g.yung mo bdag nyid dran nyams pas/ /snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig /ces bskul bas thig le de nyid hūm̐ dang am̐ sngon po 'od 'bar zhing 'jigs par gyur/ de zhu ba las bdag nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog sngon po/ zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha/ zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis gnag pa nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rang rang gi sa bon hūm̐ am̐ gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐ de rnams las 'od 'phros/ snod kyi 'jig rten la phog gzhal yas khang dang / bcud kyi sems can la phog lha dgu'i ngo bo gyur/ thams cad kyi mig tu mam̐ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar dwam̐ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma sngon mo/ snar pam̐ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ khar ram̐ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar am̐ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang khu/ snying khar nam̐ las bdag med rnal 'byor ma nag mo/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ thugs kar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje ma nag mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang / mi mgo skam po'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ ro'i gdan la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ thal mo sbyar te dkar mo ri dwags sogs nas 'khyud pa nyid/ ces pa'i bar gyis mchod/ spro na 'og nas 'byung ba'i/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs kyis bstod/ khu tshur g.yon gyi mthe'u chung dang / g.yas pa'i mdzub mo sgrel te/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes dang gau rī nag mo lcags kyu thogs pas srung 'khor gyi nang du spyan drangs/ khu tshur gnyis rgyab sprod zhags mig ltar byas la/ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra we sha ya hūm̐/ zhes dang tsau rī dmar mo zhags pa thogs pas mgrin pa la reg pas ye shes pa rnams smin mtshams nas thim/ mthe'u chung dang mdzub mo phan tshun sbrel te/ oṃ badz+ra betā lī bhan+dha baṃ/ zhes dang betā lī ser mo lcags sgrog thogs pas zhabs la reg pas dam tshig pa la ye shes pa 'dres/ khu tshur bcangs pa'i 'khrig ma gnyis bsnol te/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes dang ghasma rī ljang khu dril bu thogs pas phyi nang kun tu dril bu'i sgra byung bas/ dam tshig pa rnams ye shes pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsam/ de nas lus dkyil gsal btab cing dbang blang ba ni/ gnyis su med par thim pa'i rkyen gyis skad cig gi rang gi lus rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ spyi bo sna tshogs rdo rje/ rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rtsibs ma rdo rje'i rwa ba/ lpags pa rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ ba spu mda'i dra ba/ sen mo me ris 'bar ba ste bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang / rkang mthil rlung / sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying kha sa/ sgal tshigs ri rab/ mgo bo ri rab kyi stod kyi cha/ lus mi nyams pa med par gru bzhi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ snying kha nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i bu ga bzhi sgo bzhi/ mig pañca re kha/ sna rin po che'i pha gu/ so dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa/ lce dang mchu 'dod yon gyi snam bu/

rna ba rta bab/ rkang rnams ka ba brgyad de rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang / lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte ba'i am̐/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dang / tshor ba'i phung po rnam par dag pa/ bcom ldan 'das yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rin po che/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sa rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas spyan ma ser mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo drug cu rtsa bzhis bskor ba mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ gsang gnas bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa'i lte ba'i hā phrag dog dang 'du byed kyi phung po rnam par dag pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'phrin las don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang khu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rlung rnam par dag pa dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo so gnyis kyis bskor ba bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i lte ba'i hūm̐ zhe sdang dang rnam par shes pa'i phung po rnam par dag pa/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum chu rnam par dag pa ma mā ki sngon mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba me long lta bu'i ye shes/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i lte ba'i oṃ 'dod chags dang 'du shes kyi phung po rnam par dag pa/ bcom ldan 'das gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pad+ma/

g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum me rnam par dag pa gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang / mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo bcu drug gis bskor ba so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa'i lte ba'i ham̐ gti mug dang gzugs kyi phung po rnam par dag pa/ bcom ldan 'das sku rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum nam mkha'i khams rnam par dag pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo so gnyis kyis bskor ba chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ gtso bo lnga po thams cad dbu'i gtsug tor lta bar mi mngon pa la sogs pa mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / sen mo zangs kyi mdog ltar dmar ba la sogs pa dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ gzhan yang mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma sngon mo/ snar ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ lcer 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang khu/ snying khar bdag med rnal 'byor ma nag mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de dag gi mdun du zhal nang la phyogs pa'i tshul gyis mig tu gzugs gau rī/ rna bar sgra tsau rī/ snar dri betā lī/ lcer ro ghasma rī/ dpral bar reg sa spyod ma/ snying khar chos khams mkha' spyod ma ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ lag pa g.yas par gshin rje gshed sngon po tho ba 'dzin pa/

g.yon par shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ lcer pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ gsang gnas su bgegs mthar byed sngon po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ dpung pa g.yas par mi g.yo ba sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ g.yon par 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ pus mo g.yas par dbyug sngon can sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon par stobs po che sngon po rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ spyi gtsug tu gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su gnod mdzes rgyal po sngon po gtun shing 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ lha de thams cad kyang sku'i dbyibs/ rnam pa bde ba/ rang bzhin stong gsal/ ngo bo zung 'jug gzhan yang lus rtsa sprul pa'i sku/ rtsa yi ge longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ khams bdud rtsi chos kyi sku/ snying po ye shes rlung ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste lus rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dkar mo ri dwags sogs nas 'khyud par nyid/ ces pas mchod/ spro na/ zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje bdag la gsol/ /'dod chags rdo rje bdag la skyobs/ /yid dang phrag dog chen po kun/ /rdo rje kun gyi dam tshig mchog /las rnams thams cad sgrub byed pa/ /rdo rje can kun bdag dges mdzod/ /ces bstod/ dbang lha'i mdun du pad zla'i gdan la dbang rdzas rnams kyang yod par bsam/ tshig rnams bla mas mdzad cing / dbang rdzas rnams de'i thugs ka nas bye ba'i he ru zhig gis gtad par bsam mo/ /oṃ badz+ra bhu mi sogs nas/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/

/sogs brjod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang bskyabs pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /lan gsum/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ bdag gi rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang / /dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma ki sngon po gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mi bskyod pa yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥde bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyi/ /khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis/

/gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chu'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa dang bcas te/ dbang bskur bas dbang gi chu rgyun des smin mtshams yan chad gang bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang gsang ba'i dbang thob/ snying kha yan chad gang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams cad gang mchog tu bde ba chen po bzhi pa'i dbang thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra a lo kā+e āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i sa bon brgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ bdag gi tshor ba'i phung po dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ ām̐ las rin po che ām̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas rin po che/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu sogs nas thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥlan gnyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la sogs nas stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa sogs nas hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dbu rgyan du gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa'i/ /rin chen dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na mu ku ṭa a bi ṣiñca mi/ badz+ra ra ga ta badz+ra sha li hoḥ zhes gsungs shing cod paṇa bcings te/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa nas hūm̐/ zhes gsungs zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas cod paṇa gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sa bon brgyud la bzhag oṃ swa bhā wa nas haṃ/ bdag gi 'du shes kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du dz+riṃ las/ pad+ma dz+riṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gnyis ka'ang 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pad+ma/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu sogs nas thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'od dpag med yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan gnyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la sogs nas stsal tu gsol/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa nas hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi 'od dpag med yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs nas/ stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long / /oṃ mahā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing rdo rje byin te/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa nas zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chu'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med kyi sa bon brgyud la bzhag oṃ swa bhā wa nas haṃ/ bdag gi 'du byed kyi phung po dang / dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnyis ka'ang don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu sogs nas thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad don yod grub pa yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥlan gnyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la sogs nas stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa nas hūm̐/ zhes gsungs zhing dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi don yod grub pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs nas stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñca mi/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes gsungs shing dril bu byin te/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa nas hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chu'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa'i sa bon brgyud la bzhag oṃ swa bhā wa nas haṃ/ bdag gi gzugs kyi phung po mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du bh+rum̐ las 'khor lo bh+ruṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu sogs nas thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rnam par snang mdzad yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥde bzhin gshegs pa sogs nas stsal tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ra satwa satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñca mi badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa la'o/

zhes gsungs shing ming btags te/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa nas hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chu'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi sa bon brgyud la bzhag dngos kun gang dang gang snang ba/ /gtso de rang gi lhag pa'i lha/ /chos rnams rang bzhin snyog med dag /sangs rgyas ye shes lta bar gyis/ /oṃ swa bhā wa nas haṃ/ bdag gi phung po lnga'i chos nyid la tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag gi phung po lnga'i chos nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu sogs nas thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥde bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal tu gsol/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa nas hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chu'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu gzung / /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul shugs bsten/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa satwaṃ dha ra yā mi badz+ra satwa hāḥhi hi hi hi hūm̐/

maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du sogs brjod/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba/ /mgon pos bdag la stsal nas kyang / /'khor lo lha'i de nyid dang / /slob dpon 'phrin las yongs su gzung / /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sdom pa'ang bla na med par stsol/ /lan gsum/ 'di de sogs nas hūm̐/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu la'o/ /oṃ mahā badz+ra hūm̐/ rang gi sems nges don gyi rdo rje yin no snyam du bsam/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyis/ /dril bu'i sgra kun rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /a srid pa ngo bo nyid kyi dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa/ /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe a/ rang gi ngag nges don gyi dril bu yin no snyam du bsam/ rang nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog dkar po sogs snga ma ltar las/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje 'chang chen po yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥshes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba/ /slob dpon gyi ni dbang du brjod/ /rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung / /sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/

/dam tshig 'di ni khyod kyis long / /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci 'dod par ni brten bzhin du/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha sbyor bas/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa'i/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces su grags/ /yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /zhes sogs mi bskyod pa chu dbang ltar las/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbur brgyan/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na bla ma'i sku'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i sa bon brgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi sogs nas bla ma dam pa la gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du sogs dang / khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ /khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa/ /khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te/ /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa/ /sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje sgrub pa'i yid/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dges/ /zhes brjod/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa/ /mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po/ /rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung / /ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che/ /mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar stsol/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras bcings bar bsams la/ bla ma he ru ka lus dkyil gyi lha dang bcas pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i thig le bdag gi lce thog tu bzhag ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gi gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyi dbang bskur ro/

/oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ thig le mgrin pa nas 'phel te lus thams cad gang bas gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin brgyud la skyes par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras phye bar bsam/ de ltar na rdzas gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag lam tsaṇ+ḍa li bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i sa bon brgyud la bzhag maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi sogs nas 'di nyid shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du sogs brjod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs nas yid kyi dges zhes dang / bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye sogs nas bdag la skyobs bar lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras bcings par bsam/ bla mas/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ /khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ /khyer la mchod pa dag tu gyis/ /zhes gsungs shing phyag rgya ma zhig bdag la gtad de/ des bdag la/ bshang gci dag ni za ba dang / /khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen bsten pa bu spro 'am/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang / /bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed par/ /bu khyod ci dgar spro gyur tam/ /zhes 'dri ba la/ bshang gci dag ni za ba dang / /khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen bsten pa cis mi spro/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang / /bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed par/ /bdag ni ci dgar spro gyur to/ /zhes lan btab pas/ phyag rgya ma des/ e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gal te cho ga bzhin bsten na/ /de yi mdun na bdag 'dug ste/ /sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa/ /pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin byed/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid de/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/ /blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba/ /de la cho ga'i dngos grub med/ /satwaṃ pad+ma bhañja mok+ṣa hoḥ zhes gsung shing bdag gi mdun du byon par gyur/ rig ma bdag med mar gsal ba'i mkha' āḥlas pad+ma āḥyis mtshan pa dang /

rang nyid kyai rdo rje lus dkyil gyi lha dang bcas par gsal ba'i gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes chags kyi mes spyi bo'i haṃ zhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas mgrin par byon pas dga' ba/ snying khar byon pas mchog dga'/ lte bar byon pas dga' bral/ mkha' gsang gi rtser byang sems dkar dmar 'dzoms pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ slar rlung gi nus pas byang sems dkar dmar yar drangs te lte bar byon pas dga' ba/ snying khar byon pas mchog dga'/ mgrin par byon pas dga' bral/ spyi bor byon pas lhan skyes sngon du byas par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis mig ras phye/ de ltar na phyag rgya'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu chos sku'i sa bon brgyud la bzhag maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi sogs nas 'di nyid dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du sogs brjod/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /dbang bskur gsum po bdag la gnang / /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /bzhi pa yang ni byin gyis rlobs/ /lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis mig ras bcings par bsams/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rdul phral mthar sbyin zhi ba nyid/ /khyod rang yang ni de yi pha/ /zhes gsungs par bsams te/ de'i don/ rang nyid lus dkyil gyi lha dang bcas pa snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i sku can du snang ba sprul sku/ sems brgyud phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba las byung ba'i bde chen gyi rnam par shar ba longs sku/ lha sku bde chen gyi rnam par snang tsam de nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum thams cad dang bral ba chos sku/ de gsum ngo bo dbyer mi phyed pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ mdor na sems kyi gshis cir yang ma yin pa/ mdangs bde chen du ma 'gags pa/

rtsal lha skur 'char ba/ bsgom bya sgom byed las 'das pa nam mkha' lta bur shes par byas la 'dzin med du bzhag oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis mig ras phye/ de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i sa bon brgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi sogs nas 'di nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dbang yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu dbul bar bgyi'o/ /sogs brjod/ deng nas brtsamasate bdag bran du/ /khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ /khyod kyi slob mar gzung ba dang / /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /lan gsum/ de ltar na dbang gi chu rgyun des lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo yab yum gnyis gau rī dang puk+ka sī la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī dang sha wa rī la rnam par snang mdzad/ betā lī dang tsaṇ+ḍa lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma rī dang ḍom bī nī la 'od dpag med/ lus dkyil kyi lha thams cad la rdo rje sems dpa' re res dbur brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ bdud rtsi dngos su sbyor ram bsams kyang rung ste/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/

de'i steng du shar du go las ba glang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha sha de rnams re re'i steng du yang / shar du bh+rum̐ las dri chen/ lhor ām̐ las rak+ta/ nub tu dz+riṃ las byang sems/ byang du kham̐ las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du shar du bh+rum̐ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ lhor āṃ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dz+riṃ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ byang du kham̐ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ zla ba'i mthar g.yon bskor gyis/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ g.yas bskor gyis/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bltas pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pa rlung gi ba dan la phog pas/ rlung g.yos me 'bar bas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams bkol zhing 'od du zhu ba'i rlangs pa gyen la song bas oṃ dang rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnams he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par byon te/ rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim pas rdo rje brjid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung ba 'od du zhu nas sngar gyi bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur te/ kha dog dang dri dang ro dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ byin gyis brlabs pa g.yon pas srin lag gis blangs te myang la/ lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gsol bas bde ba'i tshim par bsams te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swā da na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rang gi snying kha nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing / dkar mo ri dwags sogs nas 'khyud par nyid/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ lha mo de rnams kyis bstod par bsam la/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs sogs nas rdo rje yid kyis dges/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes de yan chad rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par bsgom la/ rten dang brten pa snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu la sems gzung / de la brtan pa na rdzogs pa'i rim pa bla ma las ji ltar thob pa ltar nyams su blang ngo / /dag pa dran pa ni/ snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po la/ /byams pa'i thugs la yan lag nag /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yis ni/ /zhabs ni rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod/ /zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad/ /phyag ni stong pa bcu drug nyid/ /gug skyed kyis ni sangs rgyas lnga/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo nyid/ /de nyid gsum ni spyan gsum mo/ /sha ni puk+ka sī ru brjod/ /de bzhin khrag ni ri khrod ma/ /gdol pa mo ni khu bar brjod/ /g.yung mo rkang dang tshil bu dang / /lpags pa byang chub yan lag bdun/ /rus pa bden pa bzhi po nyid/ /ces brjod cing don yid la dran par bya'o/ /dag pa dran pa 'di 'og spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor gyi thog mar byas kyang nyes pa med do/ /bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ dus rgyun du dkyil 'khor bsdus nas gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyis byas kyang btub/ bsnyen pa la sogs pa'i tshe skabs 'di kho nar bya ste/ de yang yum gyi thugs ka'i aṃ las sngags kyi phreng ba byung /

zhal nas thon/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas byung ste yum gyi pad+mar zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ de yum gyi zhal nas yab kyi zhal du zhugs te rgyun mi chad par 'khor ba las/ las dang mthun pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas lha rnams dbang du 'dus par bsam la/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i phreng ba bzung ste/ oṃ aṣ+ṭa na nā ya/ rab sngags brgyad pa'i zhal can la/ piṃ gaur+dha ke sha war+dha ma ṇe/ dmar ser dbu skra gyen brdzes la/ tsa turbing+sha ti ne trā ya/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i spyan ldan la/ ṣo ḍa sha bhu dza ya/ bcu drug pa yi phyag can la/ kriṣ+ṇa dzi mū ta wa pu ṣe/ char sprin ltar nag sku can la/ ka pā la mā lā a ne kān dhā ri ṇe/ thod phreng du ma 'dzin pa la/ āt+ma kru ra tsit+ta ya/ khong nas 'khrug pa'i gzugs can la/ ar+dhen+tu daṃ ṣ+ṭī ṇe/ zla phyed lta bu'i mche gtsigs la/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ gsod cig gsod cig kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gyis shig gyis shig gardzadza ya gardzadza ya/ sgrogs shig sgrogs shig tardzadza ya tardzadza ya/ rtogs shig rtogs shig sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ skoms shig skoms shig sap+ta sā ga rān/ mtsho bdun rnams/ ban+dha ban+dha/ chings shig chings shig nā gā aṣ+ṭa kān/ klu brgyad rnams/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ zungs shig zungs shig sha trun/ dgra bo rnams/ ha hā hi hī hu hū he hai ho hau haṃ haḥphaṭ/ khos shig swāhā/ legs pa sbyin/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra/ lha 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra kartā ri rdo rje gri gug he badz+ra ya kyai rdo rje/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ yab kyi rtsa sngags kyi snying po nye snying ngo / oṃ āḥ.a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥ.am̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/

oṃ āḥnam̐ badz+ra nai rīt+mā ya rdo rje bdag med ma yi tshad/ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ rnal 'byor ma rnams dang yum gyi'o/ /oṃ āḥgam̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥgam̐ badz+ra gau rī hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥtsam̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥtsam̐ badz+ra tsau rī hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥbam̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥbam̐ badz+ra bet+ta lī hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥgham̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥgham̐ badz+ra ghasma rī hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥpam̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥpam̐ badz+ra puk+ka hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥsham̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥsham̐ badz+ra sha wa rī hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥlam̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥlam̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa lī hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥḍam̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥḍam̐ badz+ra ḍoṃ bi nī hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ 'khor gyi ste yab yum la ji tsam bzlas pa'i bcu cha bzlas la/ thal mo sbyar te/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub snying po kyai rdo rje'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pa'i mthar yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing zhes sogs gong bzhin las/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ zhes dang so so'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ ni ri zhes sogs nas shap+ta'i bar gong ltar brjod/ 'di man gyi mchod pa byin rlabs thams cad 'di bzhin go bar bya'o/ /de nas pad bskor sngon du 'gro bas so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ bhā ga wan mahā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa re re mgor sbyar ba'i/ oṃ ni ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ zhes sogs nas shap+ta'i bar 'don pa bsgyur bas phyi mchod dang /

hūm̐ am̐ gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /zhes pas nang mchod/ phyag len la 'di'i mchod pa dang bstod pa gnyis ka la rol chen mdzad/ de nas thal mo sbyar te/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis yid mchod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs kyis bstod pa rnams byas la/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu ste srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ srung ba'i 'khor lo dur khrod brgyad la/ dur khrod brgyad gzhal yas khang la/ gzhal yas khang lha mo brgyad la/ lha mo brgyad zhal brgyad la/ yum yab la thim/ zhal phyag lhag ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la thim/ rang he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sku can du gyur/ zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor bsdu'o// ༈ //de nas sa lha'i sgos mchod yod na mar me la sogs pa sbar te/ tshom bu bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i steng du bam̐ las sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo zhi ba'i nyams can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis bklubs pa/ phyag gnyis kyi rin po che'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ de'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs nas thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang khu tshur gnyis dpung mgor bsnol te se gol gyi sgra byas nas mdzub mo gnyis lcags kyu ltar bkug pa rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ 'og nas rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgya zhes 'byung ba rnams su 'di dran par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra gau rī a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes sogs bzhis dgug gzhug bcing dbang du bya/ de dag gi phyag rgya ni/ khu tshur gnyis kyi mthe chung dang / /g.yas pa'i mdzub sbrel lcags kyu ste/ /khu tshur rgyab sbyar zhags mig ltar/

/byas pa zhags pa'i phyag rgya 'o/ /mthe chung mdzub mo phan tshun du/ /so sor sbrel ba lcags sgrog yin/ /khu tshur bcangs pa'i 'khrig ma gnyis/ /bsnol ba rgyab sbyar dril bu'o/ /zhes pa ste 'og tu gau rī ma la sogs pa'i phyag rgya zhes 'byung ba rnams su 'di dran par bya'o/ /slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chu'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par bsams la/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī zhes pa so so'i mgor sbyar ba'i nī rī hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ zhes sogs nas shap+da'i bar dang / ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ gtor ma chab kyis bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi mthar gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ zhes brjod/ lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin byas la/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes sogs lan gsum se gol dang bcas pas phul/ rdor dril 'dzin pas tshigs bcad re re'i mtshams su rdo rje gsor/ dril bu bcad gtub tu dkrol la/ 'di la dril gsil rkyang pa mdzad pa bde chen rgya mtsho las bshad/ mā ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin/ /kyai yi rdo rje khros mchod pa'i/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /sa 'dir dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /shākya 'di la spos dang bcas dril gsil bya ba rnam snang mngon byang las bshad ces bde chen rgya mtsho las gsungs/ seṅge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor 'bri/

/zhes lan gsum brjod/ spro na rdo rje snying khar bzung dril bu chig brdung byas la/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / zhes sogs gong bzhin las/ 'tshal na sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ zhes pa'i mthar/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba thob par bsam/ lag pa g.yas pa sa la reg ste/ oṃ badz+ra muḥsa'i lha mo sa de nyid la thim/ zhes brjod/ sa lha'i tshom bu dang mchod gtor dman ma rnams bsdu'o// ༈ //lha sta gon ni bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang / ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje zhes pa nas me ri rab tu 'bar ba'i gang bar gyur/ oṃ rak+ṣa zhes sogs kyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ de lta bu'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba gdengs ka che ba gyen du bstan pa/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ de'i nang du yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ zhes sogs nas rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur/ de'i phyi rol tu dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i shing brgyad/ shing gi rtsa ba la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad/ de dag gi nam mkha' la gnas pa'i sprin brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i klu brgyad/ shing gi yal ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong brgyad/ gzhan yang chu brgyad/ me brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang / 'dre dang / srin po dang / mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / ro dang ro langs la sogs pas yongs su gang ba'i dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi lha snam shar dkar zhes pa nas thags bzang ris dud kha rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/

de nas hūm̐ shrī he badz+ra na maḥ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das snying po kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhes pa nas gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid ces pa'i bar dang / nam̐ nai rāt+mā na maḥ de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma zhes pa nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ gam̐ gau rī na maḥ shar du gau rī nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa zhes dang / de bzhin du tsam̐ tsau rī na maḥ lhor tsau rī/ bam̐ betā lī na maḥ nub tu betā lī/ gham̐ ghasma rī na maḥ byang du ghasma rī/ pam̐ puk+ka sī na maḥ byang shar du puk+ka sī/ sham̐ sha wa rī na maḥ shar lhor ri khrod ma/ lam̐ tsaṇ+ḍa lī na maḥ lho nub tu gdol pa mo/ ḍam̐ ḍoṃ bī nī na maḥ nub byang du g.yung mo zhes sogs nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod/ de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs nas thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ oṃ bhā ga wan mahā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pā ri wā ra zhes mtshan sngags lan gcig sbyar bas nī rī hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ zhes sogs nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod la/ gau rī la sogs pa'i sngags rgyas bstim/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ nī rī sogs nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod de/ ye shes pa dang dbang lha'i mchod pa dmigs bsal ma gtogs 'og ma rnams la'ang 'di bzhin shes par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /zhes sogs nas khyod kyis 'di la dbang bskur stsol/

/zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis/ /zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chu'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo yab yum gnyis gau rī dang zhes pa nas ghasma rī dang ḍoṃ bī nī la 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ de nas mar me la sogs pa sbar la/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas/ mdun skyed kyi gtso bo de rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang tha mi dad par bsams la/ dku g.yon par khu tshur gnyis steng 'og tu kha sbyar te/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod/ /oṃ bha ga wa na mahā zhes sogs brjod cing phyag rgya dkrol te rnam lnga pad bskor sngon du 'gro bas gong du bshad pa'i phyag rgya bcas la oṃ nī rī hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing se gol gtogs/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad dang sngags kyi thog mtha' dang phyag rgya rnams 'dra ba las/ lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi te hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ lha rdzas dam pa'i 'thor 'thung 'di/ /sarba saṃ shwadha ni swāhā/ lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkham̐ ram̐ mahā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes pas chu bzhi dbul/ de bzhin du me tog la sogs pa so so'i phyag rgya byas te/ me tog 'di ni bzang zhing dge /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod/ /oṃ bhā ga wān sbyar bas oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ de bzhin du gzhan rnams 'dra ba las/ tshal dag ro ni phan pa dang / /gang zhig dri dang bdug spos mchog /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /sogs gong bzhin las/ dhu pe/ srin po 'joms shing dag byed la/ /dges shing mun pa rnam sel ba/
