/ā lo ke 'di ni dri bzang dge ba ste/ /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /gan+dhe/ sman rnams bcud gtsang yid gar 'ong / /sngags kyi zhal zas shos 'di dag /nai wi d+ye/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i rol mo 'di/ /bdag gi sogs dang / shap+da'i mthar rol chen rgyun dkrol du byas te/ ghaṇ+ḍe ra ni sogs brjod/ gos zung bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gos srab pa 'jam pa yang ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur/ zhes dang / srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ /mi phyed rdo rje'i sku la gsol/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ bhā ga wan zhes sogs dang / oṃ badz+ra waṣ+ṭa ye āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing pad skor sngon du 'gro ba'i khu tshur gnyis kyis na bza' blangs te thog mar smad g.yogs dang / de nas stod g.yogs 'bul ba'i tshul bya zhing / lha re re la phul bar bsam mo/ /de nas g.yon pa'i srin lag gi nang mchod nas blangs te/ mthe bo'i rtses gtor la/ lha thams cad kyi phyag tu thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba re re byung bar bsam zhing / ngag tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma ngag dbang kun dga' rgyal mtshan bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas rdo rje 'chang nas rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi lam 'bras brgyud pa rnams kyi mtshan nas brjod cing dbul ba ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍa ma rū pa/ a wa dhū tī/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ bla ma se mkhar chu ba/ zhang dgon pa ba/ bla ma sa skya chen po/

slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas seng ge mtshungs med dkon mchog dpal ldan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ rje btsun nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ mkhan chen nam mkha' rin chen/ mtshungs med bsod nams rgya mtsho/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ 'dren mchog nam mkha' dpal bzang / 'jam mgon lhun grub dpal ldan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ shar chen sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin/ mtshungs med shes bya bzang po/ byams pa tshul khrims dpal bzang / mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan/ byams pa bsod nams bzang po/ 'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub/ 'jam dbyangs tshul khrims lhun grub/ byams pa nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ byams pa dpal ldan chos skyong / mkhas grub sangs rgyas dpal bzang / 'jam mgon bsod nams lhun grub/ rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan/ 'jam mgon sangs rgyas ye shes/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog grags pa/ ngag dbang chos skyong bzang po/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas grags pa/ ngag dbang phun tshogs don grub/ mkhas grub kun dga' bsod nams/ byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med/ mkhas grub ngag dbang dam chos/ byams pa bsod nams dpal 'byor/

byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ ngag dbang blo gros bzang po/ dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ byams pa dpal ldan bzang po/ rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po/ ngag dbang blo gros bstan 'dzin/ kun dga' bstan pa'i blo gros/ byams pa kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub/ sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen/ 'dren mchog sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs byams pa dpal ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag nos/ chos kyi 'brel pa thob pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas/ aṣ+ṭa dang / de wa pi tsu dang / karta ri dang / oṃ āḥ.a ā i ī sogs dang / oṃ āḥgam̐ hūm̐ phaṭ sogs nas/ oṃ āḥḍam̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar brjod cing bcom ldan 'das snying po kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas rang gi lce rtse/ smin mtshams/ spyi gtsug rnams su thig le byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas lus dkyil gyi lha rnams mchod par bsam/ sta gon gyi nyin skabs 'dir gtor ma rnams la bar phud bran la/ de nas/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ mahā kā li de wi ye/ dharmā pā la tsa turmu khā sa pa ri wā ra/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' bstod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

gzhan yang chos 'khor srung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dpal mgon dam tshig can rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing / tshan+dho dang nye ba'i tshan+dho/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ 'thung spyod dang nye ba'i 'thung spyod/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ yul sum cu so gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul pa'i sku 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang / gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bod khams skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas bzhis 'dus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde bas brgyud gang nas myur du bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas rang gis kyang myang la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas dril bu gsum brdung bya zhing / rang gi snying kha nas lha mo brgyad sprul te mchod par bsam/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs dang / de rnams kyis bstod par bsam ste/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs sogs dang / bstod pa nyi shu pa sogs ci shes pas bstod la/ pus mo btsugs te spos dang bcas pas/ rdor dril 'dzin bzhin pas/

dril bu bcad gtubs su dkrol zhing / hūm̐/ he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rig pa'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dkyil 'khor thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /mgon po bdag ni 'dri bar 'tshal/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa lags/ /de bas bka' drin mdzad par 'os/ /'gro ba 'khor lo'i don mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /'bras gnas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /sngags kyi lha gzhan gang lags dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang / /gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang / /sangs rgyas bstan la dga' ba dang / /gang su rdo rje spyan ldan rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ /he zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ /yo byad ci 'byor pa dag gis/ /'gro ba dag phyir bdag 'dri bas/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs rjes thugs dpag mdzad nas kyang / /dkyil 'khor par bcas thams cad kyis/ /thugs rje'i dgongs nas gnang bar mdzod/ ces lan gsum brjod pas/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod gzhan don rgya che bar gyis shig ces gnang ba thob par bsam// ༈ //bum pa sta gon ni/ skabs 'di'am/ gnas skabs gzhan du'ang rung / gong du bshams pa'i bum pa bsang sbyangs/ /stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi steng du bh+rum̐ las rin po che'i bum pa gnyis yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum par sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du nyon mongs pa la sogs pa bdud bzhi'i ngo bo tshangs pa ser po sogs nas steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/

shar du tshangs pa ser po zhes sogs nas thags zangs ris dud kha rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan/ las thams cad pa'i bum par pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo skar ma'i phreng ba lta bu'i a ā zhes sogs sgrub thabs bzhin las/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo bcom ldan 'das snying po kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhes sogs nas gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te sogs 'dra ba las/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pas thig le cha dgur gyur/ de rnams gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐ hūm̐ rnams su gyur/ de rnams lha mo brgyad bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang bcas pa rnams su gyur nas/ yum gyi mkha' nang nas phyir thon te gdan so so'i steng du 'khod pa ni/ shar du gau rī nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ zhes sogs nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi lha mo rnams dang / las thams cad pa'i bum par bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ rin po che dang / sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskum pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs nas thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyai rdo rje lha dgu bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang bcas pa'i rnam par rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs la/

de la mchod pa dang dgug gzhug bya ba dang / dbang lha spyan drangs te mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa dang / dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas 'debs pa rnams gong bzhin las/ ḍom+bi nī la 'od dpag med ces pa'i rjes su/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan zhes brjod/ de nas oṃ bha ga wān zhes sogs re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ hūm̐ am̐ gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐ hūm̐ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kyai rdo rje lha dgu bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /zhes pas nang mchod 'phul/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs dang / khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs kyi mthar/ don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung / /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces sogs kyis bstod la/ pad skor byas nas gzungs thag blangs te/ bdag gi snying kha nas sngags kyi phreng ba dmar po/ gzungs thag la 'khril nas song ba bum nang gi lha rnams la phog pas lha rnams dmar lam lam song ste bdag gi dbang du 'dus shing ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar gyur bar bsam la/ yab yum gyi snying po gnyis dang / 'khor gyi sngags thung rnams dang / las bum la 'khyil pa'i sngags rnams brgya rtsa re bzla/ slar yang gong ltar mchod bstod byas la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka zhes sogs yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod de/ gzungs thag bsdus la/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /ces pa'i mthar pad skor sngon du 'gro bas dung chos blangs nas/ bum pa rnams su chu thig re blug ste/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa'i mthar/ mchod yon 'phul ba'i rkyen gyis lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ ces brjod/ de nas gtor ma rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes pa nas ha hoḥhriḥ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi dur khrod brgyad du hūm̐ brgyad yongs su gyur pa las shar du rgya byin zhes sogs dang / dbang ldan gyi dur khrod kyi steng gi char chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang / 'dab ma brgyad la oṃ dgu yongs su gyur ba las/ dbus su sku rdo rje/ shar du dbang phyug chen po zhes sogs dang / srin po'i dur khrod kyi 'og gi char chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang / 'dab ma brgyad la āḥdagu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su gsung rdo rje/ shar du stobs kyi rgyu zhes sogs nas thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'byung po brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rnam par rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ dgug gzhug bya/ dbang lha spyan drangs la mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa dang / dbang bskur ba rnams gtor chog ltar byas la/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad dang bcas pa la rnam par snang mdzad/ phyogs skyong brgyad la mi bskyod pa/ gsung rdo rje klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsam la/ mchod gtor 'phul ba nas mchod bstod 'phrin las bcol ba'i bar gtor chog ltar bya/ sgos kyi chos skyong rnams kyi gtor ma dang / mkha' 'gro spyi gtor logs nas 'byung ba ltar phul la bskang ba bstod pa sogs phyag len ltar byas la dril gsil dang bcas/ lha'i tshogs rnams sogs nas kun 'grub shog gi bar gong bzhin gyi rjes la/

kol+la i ri t+ṭhi a bo lā/ kol+la'i rir gnas rdo rje ma/ mum+mu ṇi re kak+ko lā/ mo ma mu nir gnas pad+ma'o/ gha ṇe kri bi ṭa ho bādz+dza i/ kye ho tshogs su cang te'u dkrol/ ka ru ṇe ki a i na ro lā/ snying rje'i ku co mi bya'o/ /ta hiṃ ba la khadz+dza ī/ de ru sha ni za bar bya/ gā ḍheṃ ma a ṇa bidz+dza ī/ 'bad pas chang ni btung bar bya/ ha le ka līñja ra pa ṇi a i/ kye ho skal ldan gzhug par bya/ dun+du ra bīdz+dzi a ī/ skal med rnams ni spang bar bya/ tsa us ma kats+tsha ri si h+lā/ bzhi mnyam gla rtsi tu ru ṣ+ka/ kā p+pu ra lā i a i/ ga bur rnams ni byug par bya/ mā la in+dha ṇa sā liñja/ tshod ma dang ni sha chen po/ ta hiṃ ba ru khā i a i/ der ni mang du bza' bar bya/ phreṃ kha ṇā kha ṭa ka ran+te/ 'ong pa dang ni 'gro bar bya/ shud+dha a shud+dha na mu ṇi a i/ dag dang ma dag dmigs mi bya/ ni raṃ su aṃ ge tsa ḍā wi/ rus pa'i rgyan ni lus la gdags/ ta hiṃ dza sa ra wa pa ṇi a i/ de ni skyes pa'i ro gzhug bya/ ma la a dze kun du ru bā ṭa i/ 'du bar 'khrig la 'jug par bya/ ḍin+ḍi ma ta hin+na bādz+dzi a i/ der ni reg min spang mi bya/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po yin/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa yin/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyi mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/

/de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa yin/ /zhes bkra shis brjod/ rigs su skyes dang dam tshig can/ /smyo med kyai yi rdo rje ston/ /bla ma la gus snying rje ldan/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur ba shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ /zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang / /btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur ba shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ /gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba/ /de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces smon lam btab// ༈ //rjes chog ni/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la/ re re'i mgor oṃ bhā ga wan zhes sogs sbyar ba'i chu bzhi nyer spyod rol chen dang bcas pa dang / nang mchod 'phul la/ hūm̐ am̐ gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /zhes dang rol chen dang bcas te/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs dang / khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs sogs bya/ 'og tu phyi nang yid byung gi bstod pa rnams bya/ zhes 'byung ba rnams su 'di bzhin shes par bya'o/ /de nas thal mo sbyar te/ he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum bzla/ ma 'byor ba dang zhes sogs kyi mthar khu tshur gnyis kyi mthe'u chung sbrel mdzub mo brkyang ste rtse sprad pa gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor ldog ste/ oṃ badz+ra ut+tiṣ+ṭha/ sta gon gyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad sang spyan ma drangs kyi bar du mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod la/ slar yang phyi nang yid 'byung gi bstod pa rnams byas te/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/

chos skyong gi bris sku sogs gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la thal mo sbyar te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang sku gzugs kyi rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams/ ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor/ sku gzugs kyi rten med na de rnams mi dgos so/ /de nas rten med pa rnams la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra muḥ zhes dang mtheb srin gyi se gol byas la/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes dang / mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ /zhes sogs gsal btab la/ smon lam dang bkra shis 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bya'o/ /lnga pa bri zhing rgyan dgram pa ni/ lag len bzhin du las thig gdab la/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus sam ji ltar rigs pa'i gzhi la dbus su tshon sngon po la rdo rje'i rtses hūm̐ bri/ de bzhin du shar du dkar po la bh+rum̐/ lhor ser po la āṃ/ nub tu dmar po la dz+riṃ/ byang du ljang khu la kham̐ bris la bzhag tshon so so'i steng du kha dog dang mthun pa'i thig skud rnams kyang bzhag mdun du mchod pa lnga dang gtor ma/ rang kyai rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis thig tshon bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lnga'i steng du thig tshon sngon po hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/

g.yas brgyad rdo rje/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum ma mā ki sngon mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ de bzhin du dkar po bh+rum̐ las rnam snang dkar po/ g.yas brgyad 'khor lo/ g.yon brgyad des yu bar byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo/ phyag mtshan kun la 'dra/ ser mo āṃ las rin 'byung ser po/ g.yas brgyad rin po che/ g.yon 'dra/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo/ dmar po dz+riṃ las 'od dpag med dmar po/ g.yas brgyad pad+ma/ g.yon 'dra/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo/ ljang khu kham̐ las don yod grub pa ljang khu/ g.yas brgyad ral gri/ g.yon 'dra/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu/ phyag mtshan 'dra/ bsdu na rigs lnga zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bskyed kyang rung / thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi mig g.yas pa ma las nyi ma/ g.yon pa ṭa las zla ba/ mig 'bras gnyis hūm̐ yig 'bar bar gyur bar bsams la/ mig gi rdzi ma gyen thur du brdab cing / sta gon gyi lha de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi thig tshon rigs lnga'i rnam par byon te/ dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod/ nam mkha'i lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chu'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs lnga so sos dbur brgyan par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang / a kā ro mu khaṃ gis 'phul te/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes nyer gcig bzla/ g.yon pas mtheb srin gyis tshon rnams la reg cing yi ge rnams bsubs la/ lha rnams 'od du zhu ste de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdul phra rab las grub pa'i thig tshon du gyur/

ces brjod/ thig tshon rnams slob dpon gyi lag pas blangs te/ gau rī nga rgyal gyis 'dzin pas slob ma la thig skud sngo dkar ser dmar ljang khu'i rim pas thig sna gtad de brkyangs la/ phan tshun rjes su rtogs pa ste/ /chos kun phan tshun rjes su rtogs/ /chos rnams thams cad shin tu yang / /kun tu 'gro bar chos kun brjod/ /ces brjod cing dang po so so dang / de nas lhan cig tu bsgril bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gnyis su med par gyur bar bsams la/ rdo rje la dkris te mtheb srin gyi bdud rtsi gtor la gzhag go /de nas slob dpon langs la dkyil 'khor gyi nub nas shar du bltas nas/ thig skud dkris pa'i rdo rje rang gi lte ba'i thad du bzung la/ shar nas nub tu phyogs pa'i slob ma la dz+dzaḥganyis brjod cing thig sna gtad/ des kyang dz+dzaḥganyis brjod cing blangs te lte ba'i thad du bzung / slob dpon gyis/ oṃ badz+ra su tra sa ma ya mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs/ /'gro don mdzad dus 'dir lags pas/ /khyed rnams 'dir ni gshegs gsol bar/ /thig skud sgras ni bskul ma 'debs/ /zhes brjod cing / dang por steng nas 'og tu bcus te/ nam mkha' la gyen du gdab/ de nas sa la phab ste thig chen brgyad po'i steng du btab pas/ dkyil 'khor du lam gyi byung bar bsam/ de'i tshe thig skud kyi sgras sangs rgyas thams cad bskul te nam mkha'i khams su byon nas byin gyis brlabs par bsams la gdab bo/ /'debs pa'i go rim ni/ nub shar lho byang me dbang ldan/ /rlung srin rlung dbang me srin po/ /g.yas skor rgyab 'gros tshangs logs gdab/ /me rlung srin dbang g.yas skor du/ /rgyab 'gros spangs te zur thig gdab/ /nub shar gnas pas thig skud bsdu/ /nyis 'debs dang po slob dpon dang / /phyi ma slob mar shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /de nas gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor ldog ste/

oṃ badz+ra be ga kra ma hoḥ zhes brjod pas ye thig nam mkhar btegs nas slob dpon nang du bzhugs te/ gzhi bca' pad skor sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje snying kha dang / dril bu dkur brten te/ hī hī/ zhes brjod cing khro bo'i blta bas sgo bzhi la shar nas g.yas skor du bltas pas/ sgo rnams dbye bar bsams/ sgo bzhi thad kyi rtsa thig rnams dri bzang gi chus phyis la/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i gegs su gyur pa thams cad dbye bar bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod/ de nas slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su shar du phyogs pas 'dug la/ chos dbyings 'di ni rnam par dag /sems can khams ni sgrol bar byed/ /kyai yi rdo rje rgyal po che/ /dkyil 'khor snying po bri bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing / nang nas rim pa bzhin nag po/ ljang gu/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po'i rim pas sgo tshad gcig tsam bris la thod pa la sogs pas kha bcad nas steng du rdo rje gcig bzhag ste/ mchod pa lngas mchod/ dbus kyi phur khung 'og nas dkar po la sogs pas rim pas bkang la/ de nas slob ma la sogs pas dbus nas rim pas bris/ rtsig pa sbrel ran pa na thod pa bsal te sbrel/ mtshan ma brtags la ngan na nam mkha'i lha la mchod gtor phul te 'khyil bas bsrung ngo / /tshon gyi kha dog ni/ dbus kyi nyi ma dmar po la/ /pad lte sngon po ze'u 'bru ljang / /pad 'dab lha mo'i mdog can nam/ /phyogs mdog mdzes tshon gang rung bya/ /gdung zlum nag po rdo rje ser/ /lha rnams phyogs mdog bum pas brgyan/ /gtso bo'i gnas su thod pa ni/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa dang / /gri gug nag po gdan bcas bris/ /lha mo'i gnas su rang rang gi /g.yas kyi phyag mtshan gdan bcas bri/ /'dod yon dmar po pha gu ser/ /dra ba'i gzhi sngo dra ba dkar/ /mda' yab khra bo phyi thig sngo/ /mun pa glang rgyab gnyis ka nag

/ka ba ka rgyan ra phyogs mdog /rta babs dmar sngo ljang ser rim/ /pad+ma chos 'khor gdugs ci mdzes/ /nyi dkyil ljang khu pad+ma yi/ /'dab ma sna tshogs phyi dmar skya/ /dur khrod gzhi nag mtshan ma rnams/ /so so'i mdog can ci nus pa/ /rdo ra nag po rdo rje dkar/ /me ris sna tshogs su bri 'o/ /bri ba rdzogs nas tshon gyi lhag /ye thig srad bu bcas bsdus la/ /mchod pa lngas mchod oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /badz+ra muḥyis ye shes pa/ /gshegs shing sprul pa rang la thim/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi nye logs kun byung dang / dri bzang po byugs la mchod pa ci 'byor pa bshams te/ spos dang rol mo dang bcas te slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas rnam rgyal dang / slob ma rnams kyis bum pa lhag ma rim pas bzung la dkyil 'khor la bskor ba byas te/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis lha so so'i sngags kyi mthar/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod cing / lha so so'i gnas su/ de dang de'i bum pa lan res phul la/ mthar dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mtshams rnams su bum gdan gyi steng du gzhag bum pa gnyis las med na rnam rgyal lha grangs bzhin bskyar te phul la mthar shar ngos su gzhag las bum 'bul ba'i tshe 'khyil pa bzlas la/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi bar chad thams cad bsrung du gsol/ zhes brjod cing phyi'i byang shar la nye bar gzhag go /dngos gzhi'i nyin par dkyil 'khor la/ /spyi dang so so'i mchod pa rnams/ /rdul tshon ltar na zlum po dang / /ras bris ltar na gru bzhir bsham/ /'das dang 'jig rten sngon 'gro dang / /phyi rol gtor ma mchod sogs bcas/ /nye mkho thams cad tshogs bya 'o/ /drug pa sgrub cing mchod pa ni/ phyi ma red dam ji ltar 'os pa'i dus su slob dpon stan la 'dug pa la/ sngon 'gro rnam gsum nas brtsams te/ bzlas pa'i rjes kyi gsol gdab kyi bar sta gon gyi skabs ji lta ba bzhin byas la/

yig brgya tshar gsum byas nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i tshe/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ lha mo brgyad zhal brgyad la thim/ zhes brjod/ de nas mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni/ /bris la bdag nyid bsres byas nas/ /mngal 'byin sta gon dam ye bsre/ /de la ye shes spyan drangs pas/ /rten la drug dang 'khor la lnga/ /gtso bo drug bsres bsdus pa'i lugs/ /zhes te rten gyi bskyed chog mi dgos par bris pa tsam la/ bdag mdun 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bsres la mngal 'byin man chad 'dra bar byas na bsdus par 'gyur ro/ /bris dang bskyed dang bdag nyid bsre/ /mngal 'byin sta gon dam ye dang / /ye shes bsres pas lha 'dra yang / /rten la bdun bsres 'byung phyir rgyas/ /zhes te de'i grub tshul ni/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje zhes sogs kyis thun mong ba'i srung 'khor bskyed nas/ thags zangs ris dud kha rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan/ zhes pa'i bar sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar byas la/ de nas/ bdag gis bsgom pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo dang mdun bskyed kyi srung ba'i 'khor lo gnyis su med par gyur/ bdag gis bsgom pa'i dur khrod brgyad dang mdun bskyed kyi dur khrod brgyad gnyis su med par gyur/ bdag gis bsgom pa'i gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa dang / mdun bskyed kyi gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa gnyis su med par gyur/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i yum gyi mkha' la mi dmigs te/ zhes sogs sgrub thabs bzhin las/ yum gyi mkhar bab pas thig le cha gnyis su gyur/ cha gcig yongs su gyur pa las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa/

sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis mdzes shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyi rol tu dur khrod brgyad srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas par gyur/ cha gcig cha dgur gyur pa gdan so so'i steng du rim pa bzhin du 'khod pa ni/ dbus kyi thig le gtso bo yab yum/ shar gyi thig le gau rī/ lho'i thig le tsau rī/ nub kyi thig le bai ta lī/ byang gi thig le ghasma rī/ byang shar gyi thig le puk+ka sī/ shar lho'i thig le ri khrod ma/ lho nub kyi thig le gdol pa mo/ nub byang gi thig le g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs su gyur/ mkha' nang gi gtso bo yab yum dpag tu med par spros/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab/ sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang dang rnam par shes pa'i phung po sbyangs/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus rang la thim pa ni/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das snying po kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhes pa nas gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /bar/ mkha' nang gi gau rī dpag tu med par spros/ sems can thams cad kyi gti mug dang gzugs kyi phung po sbyangs/ me long lta bu'i ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus shar du tshangs pa'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ gau rī nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ mkha' nang gi tsau rī dpag tu med par spros/ sems can thams cad kyi nga rgyal dang ser sna dang tshor ba'i phung po sbyangs/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus lhor dbang po'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ tsau rī dmar mo zhes sogs zhal phyag kun la gsal gdab/ mkha' nang gi bai ta lī dpag tu med par spros/ sems can thams cad kyi 'dod chags dang 'du shes kyi phung po sbyangs/ sor rtog pa'i ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus nub tu nye dbang gi gdan la 'khod pa ni bai ta lī ser mo sogs dang / mkha' nang gi ghasma rī dpag tu med par spros/

sems can thams cad kyi phrag dog dang 'du byed kyi phung po sbyangs/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus byang du drag po'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ ghasma rī ljang khu sogs dang / mkha' nang gi puk+ka sī dpag tu med par spros/ sems can thams cad kyi sa'i khams sbyangs/ byams pa tshad med pa la bkod/ tshur 'dus byang shar du gshin rje'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ puk+ka sī sngon mo sogs dang / mkha' nang gi ri khrod ma dpag tu med par spros/ sems can thams cad kyi chu'i khams sbyangs/ snying rje tshad med pa la bkod/ tshur 'dus shar lhor nor bdag gi gdan la 'khod pa ni ri khrod ma dkar mo zhes sogs dang / mkha' nang gi gdol pa mo dpag tu med par spros/ sems can thams cad kyi me'i khams sbyangs/ dga' ba tshad med pa la bkod/ tshur 'dus lho nub tu srin po'i gdan la 'khod pa ni gdol pa mo sngon mo zhes sogs dang / mkha' nang gi g.yung mo dpag tu med par spros/ sems can thams cad kyi rlung gi khams sbyangs/ btang snyoms tshad med pa la bkod/ tshur 'dus nub byang du thags zangs ris kyi gdan la 'khod pa ni/ g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa zhes pa nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / mkha' nang gi gzhal yas khang dpag tu med par spros/ sems can thams cad kyi ma dag pa snod kyi 'jig rten sbyangs/ dag pa byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi rtog pa la bkod/ tshur 'dus mdun bskyed kyi gzhal yas khang la thim/ mkha' nang gi dur khrod brgyad dpag tu med par spros/ sems can thams cad kyi lus kyi bu ga dgu dang / 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi rnam rtog sbyangs/ sgyu ma la sogs pa'i dpe brgyad dang / 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi blta ba la bkod/ tshur 'dus mdun bskyed kyi dur khrod brgyad la thim/ mkha' nang gi srung ba'i 'khor lo dpag tu med pa spros/

sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad tshar bcad/ lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje gsum gyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus mdun bskyed kyi srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ zhes brjod de rkang don du spro ba'o/ phyag len la 'di mdzad/ byung rdzogs su spro na/ mngal du dkyil 'khor bskyed nas/ mkha' nang gi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa yum gyi bha ga nas phyir spros/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab ste/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas tshur 'dus mdun bskyed kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsam mo/ /yang na gzhan rnams gong bzhin las/ /rang nyid shar gyi sgo khang du/ /gtso bo yab yum rnal 'byor gyis/ /gnas pas mngal 'byin byas kyang rung / /de tshe gtso bo sngags bsres 'gyur/ /zhes te cho ga gong 'og gzhan thams cad 'dra ba las/ bdag mdun bsre ba'i tshe rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su phyin pa'i dmigs pa dor nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs kyi sgo khang du gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i mkha' gsang byin rlabs man gong du bshad pa bzhin byas la/ gtso bo mngal 'byin byas pa'i rjes su tshur 'dus dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du 'khod pa ni/ zhes sogs kyis gsal btab/ 'og tu rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las he ru kar bye ba'i dmigs pa dor la/ shar sgor gnas bzhin par de nyid kyis mchod pa 'bul ba sogs la 'jug pa ni/ lugs gcig go /de nas/ lha de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ zhes sogs nas thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma zhes pa'i bar brjod la/ dngos gzhi dang po'i tshe lag pas rdo rje gsor zhing / snying kha'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis sta gon gyi lha'i phyir brang gi bgegs thams cad bskrad par bsams la/ ngag tu aṣ+ṭa bzla/ sta gon gyi lha nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/

oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān zhes sogs lan gcig sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ nī rī sogs chu bzhi tsam phul la/ gau rī la sogs pa'i sngags rgyas dgug gzhug bya ste/ 'di dngos gzhi gnyis pa man chad la mi dgos so/ /de nas rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ gong ltar chu bzhis mchod la/ gau rī sogs pas dgug gzhug bya'o/ /slar yang rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang lha spyan drangs/ de la mchod pa/ dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas 'debs pa rnams sta gon bzhin bya/ de nas lha rnams la dmigs la/ hūm̐ shrī he badz+ra oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka zhes sogs yig brgya ci rigs bzla/ de bzhin du/ nam̐ nai rāt+ma oṃ shrī badz+ra zhes sogs dang / gam̐ gau rī oṃ shrī badz+ra/ tsam̐ tsau rī oṃ shrī badz+ra/ bam̐ bai ta lī oṃ shrī/ gham̐ ghasma rī oṃ shrī/ pam̐ puk+ka sī oṃ shrī/ sham̐ sha wa rī oṃ shrī/ lam̐ tsaṇ+ḍa lī oṃ shrī/ ḍam̐ ḍom+bhi nī oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka zhes sogs ci rigs bzlas pas rjes su rdo rje thal mo sbyar la/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor ba thams cad brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams te/ chu bzhi nyer spyod/ gos zung / nang mchod/ yid byung / bstod thung / bstod ring rnams sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin byas la/ rang gi lce la bdud rtsi myangs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ snying kha'i hūm̐ lha thams cad kyi ngo bo mnyes par bsams te/ 'di ma chad pa gal che'o/ /de nas rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas bye ste he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sku can du gyur/

zhes brjod/ de nas sgrub grogs gcig aṣ+ṭa bzla zhing / dkyil 'khor bsrung du bcug la/ rang nyid grogs dang bcas pa sgrub khang gi phyi'am/ dkyil 'khor dang yol ba'i bar du gcod pa'i sar phyin la/ ji ltar 'os pa'i stegs la gtor ma gcig dang / de'i g.yas su chu bzhi/ g.yon du nyer spyod lnga mdun nas rgyab tu sgreng tshar du bsham/ mdun du nang mchod kyang bshams la/ gtor ma la chab kyis bran te/ rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pas gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar e e e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum gsum brtsegs kyi nang du pam̐ pam̐ pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa re re/ steng gi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang / 'dab ma brgyad la oṃ dgu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su sku rdo rje sogs dang / bar gyi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang / 'dab ma brgyad la hūm̐ dgu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su thugs rdo rje/ shar du brgya byin sogs dang / 'og gi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang / 'dab ma brgyad la āḥdagu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su gsung rdo rje/ zhes sogs nas dbang bskur ba'i bar sngar ltar 'dra ba las/ sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad dang bcas pa la rnam par snang mdzad/ thugs rdo rje phyogs skyong brgyad la mi bskyod pa/ gsung rdo rje klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ zhes pa'i mthar/ oṃ nī ri zhes sogs kyi chu bzhi dang / oṃ iṇ+ḍa dza ma sogs kyis gtor ma phul/ mchod pa nas bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang stong grogs mdzod cig ces pa'i bar sngon 'gro gtor ma'i skabs bzhin brjod/ de nas dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol la/ rdo rje'i glu/ bkra shis smon lam bya/ de'i tshe sgrub grogs kyis zhal zas nas brtsams te 'thor 'thung gi bar gyi mchod pa rnams g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gtor snod du bsdus la/

slob dpon gyi mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā sarba pā pam̐ ni tsa s+ya sho dha ya sarba bi kalpan a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de'i tshe slob mas mchod yon gyi chus gtor snod la bskor te lhag ma gtor ma 'gro phyogs su bsgreng la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha ḍi ḍo me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sha shwa to me bha wa/ hri da yam+me a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+ta shre yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ma me muñca/ badz+ri bha wa mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥ zhes gur nas 'byung ba'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs sh+lau ka gcig gi mthar/ muḥzhes dang / lag pa g.yas pa sa la reg pas gtor mgron sgrub khang gi phyogs mtshams rnams su gshegs par bsam zhing / sgrub mchod rjes ma'i nyin/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ zhes brjod/ gang ltar yang oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas rang dang sgrub grogs kyi gnas gsum bsrungs la/ gtor ma rol mo dang bcas pas gtsang sar bskyal te/ aṣ+ṭa bzla zhing rol mo rgyun chags dang bcas pas/ slob dpon gyis rting mnan nas nang du log ste/ yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing shong na dngos su dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum mam/ bdun la sogs pa bya/ mi shong na/ 'dod yon gyi steng nas byas par bsam la/ mthar dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs nas rdo rje thal mo sbyar te/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyi mthar/ bdag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / bying ba dang rgod pa'i dbang du gyur pa dang / cho ga lhag chad du gyur pa dang / mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor ba dang / nyams pa la sogs pa dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub pa la skyon du gyur pa gang lags pa de dag thams cad bzod par mdzad de lhag chad kha skong bar mdzad du gsol/

zhes brjod cing rdor dril 'dzin bzhin pas phyag byas nas gral la 'dug go/ ༈ //bdun pa 'jug cing dbang blang ba la/ thog mar bdag nyid 'jug pa ni/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi 'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing las bum gyi chus kha bshal la/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo de rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma yin par mos te/ bla mas mdzad dgos pa rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang / dbang rdzas 'grim pa rnams de'i thugs ka nas bye ba'i he ru ka zhig gis mdzad par bsam zhing dngos su thams cad rang nyid kyis byas la/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ bdag med ma yis mgrin 'khyud pa'i/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum dang / sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /zhes sogs rigs lnga'i sdom gzung lan gsum byas la/ a khaṃ wi ra hūm̐/ zhes pas mig ras 'ching tshul bya/ /sngags de nyid kyis me tog gi phreng ba blang / gtso bo'i thugs ka nas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i tshogs dpag tu med par spros te dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par bsam la/ a mṛ ta bzla zhing las bum gyi chus gtor/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ zhes dang / skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/

/zhes pas dris lan dang po dang / de yi bu la ci zhig bya/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /zhes pas dris lan gnyis pa byas par bsam la/ rang gi snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa da ya mi/ zhes dang snying khar rdo rje bzhag la/ su ra ti sa ma ya satwaṃ hoḥsid+dhi badz+ra ya tha su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ gsang bar gdams pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su rab tu zhugs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma bzhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /zhes brjod/ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐/ zhes pa'am/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas gtso bo'i drung du bzhag par bsams la dkyil 'khor la mgo dud tsam bya/ phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la gzhag pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bo dang / ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya yi/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra ba mi bya ste/ bu khyod dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ zhes brjod/ nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la gzhag pa ni/ rdo rje snying kha dang / he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu bral te gshegs/ /zhes dang / slar yang spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste/ gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na 'dis khyod kyi mgo bo 'gems par 'gyur ro/ /zhes brjod/ gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la gzhag pa ni/

rnam rgyal gyi chu dung chos su blugs pa'am/ bdag 'jug gi skabs 'dir/ nang mchod nas myang la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ pañca a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha/ zhes brjod/ bla ma'i bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la gzhag pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bo dang / deng phyin chad bu khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di byos shig ces bya ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ /nga la yang brnyes par ma byed cig byas na ya nga ba ma spang bar 'chi ba'i dus byas nas sems can dmyal ba chen por ltung ba 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig zhes sogs nas/ ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes sogs brjod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab par mdzod cig zhes lan gsum brjod/ rang nyid he ru kar gsal ba'i rkang pa gnyis kyi 'og tu yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs pa lta bu chang zung thur du bstan cing / mchog ma gnyis gyen du bstan pa la g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du rkang pa gnyis bgrad nas gnas pa'i rkang mthil gnyis su yi ge dzhaiṃ ljang khu drag cing bzod par dka' ba re re/ gsum mdor raṃ las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ dang me 'bar bas mtshan pa/ snying khar lam̐ las byung ba'i sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po zur bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang lte ba la lam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par waṃ las byung ba'i chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pa la as mtshan pa/ spyi bor yaṃ las byung ba'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba 'khrigs pa lta bu'i dbus su has mtshan pa/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ rkang 'og gi rlung la phog pas rlung g.yos/

rkang mthil gyi dzhaiṃ mer 'bar long bu gnyis kyi rtsa nas zhugs/ brla'i rtsa bo che la yar mar khyug khyug song / sum mdor gzhi gnas kyi me dang khrug chil te 'dres pas drag tu 'bar bas snying kha'i sa bsros/ des mgrin pa'i chu bskol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song bas spyi bo'i rlung g.yos/ mthur du bus pas mgrin pa'i chu'i zegs ma snying kha'i sa la thim pas bde ba dang / lte ba'i me 'bar bas drod skyes nas snying khar bde drod 'dzoms pa la brten nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ slar yang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad bcom ldan 'das snying po kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi sku'i rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab par spyan drangs/ rkang 'og gi rlung gis yar bteg spyi bo'i rlung gis mthur du mnan te lus bar snang du 'dar yed yed gnas pa'i spyi bo dang / ba spu'i bu ga nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad kha ba babs pa bzhin sib sib thim par gyur/ zhes brjod cing gtso bos mdzad par bsam zhing rdo rje dril bu dkrol te/ hūm̐ a ha dzhaiṃ zhes dang / a be sha ya satwaṃ bha ya satwaṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya/ hūm̐ a ha dzhaiṃ/ zhes brjod/ bdag 'jug gi tshe rdzas kyi dud pa dang / spog chog mi mdzad/ brtan pa'i phyir spyi bor rdo rje rgya grwam bzhag ste/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod/ dril bu bcad gtubs su dkrol la/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang / /bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog /rigs ni gang gi snod du gyur/ /'di la bsod nams ci yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ nam mkha'i kha dog brtags la/

dkar ser dmar nag ljang khu'am sna tshogs su mthong na/ zhi rgyas dbang drag sna tshogs rnams 'grub bo snyam du dran par byas la/ dril bu chig brdung du dkrol zhing / zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces sogs kyis bstod de/ gtso bo'i dbu la me tog phul bar bsams la/ oṃ pra tī ts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes brjod cing dbul/ he ru ka des/ oṃ pra tī gṛh+ṇa satwaṃ i maṃ satwa mahā ba la/ zhes me tog phog pa'i lha la zhus pas lha des me tog de rang gi spyi bor bzhag par bsams te/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /he badz+ra pa sh+ya/ zhes pas mig ras dkrol bar bsam la/ thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che/ /me tog gang du lhung gyur pa/ /de ni khyod kyi he ru ka /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /khyod kyang sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang / /sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis/ /lha ngo sprad pa yar blangs te dkyil 'khor bstan pas ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad mthong bar mos la/ bla ma'i zhabs la phyag byas par bsams te/ oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag zhugs so/ /oṃ rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor de ring bdag gis mthong / /oṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang bskur/ /sa ma ya ho ho ho/ zhes brjod/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab ces sogs nas/ /rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes sogs dang / byang chub rdo rje sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/

dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ rta bab bzhis mdzes shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du seṅge'i khri pad+ma nyi ma bdud bzhi brtsigs pa'i gdan gyi steng du rang nyid/ bcom ldan 'das snying po kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po/ zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ yum rdo rje bdag med ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur pa'i steng du gdugs dkar po/ g.yas su rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du ba dan/ 'khor yug tu mchod pa sna tshogs kyis bskor ba dang bcas par gyur par bsam la/ oṃ nī rī zhes sogs gsum dang oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐/ zhes chu bzhis sbyangs la/ bdag gi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sdig pa'i sa bon kaṃ yig gi rnam pas sna sgor thon nas mdun gyi til la thim pa he ru kas mes bsregs shing chur dor bar bsams pa'am/ yang na yungs kar gyis sbyangs par bsams la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya/ badz+ra satwa s+ya/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na swāhā/ zhes brjod cing g.yas pas g.yas dang / g.yon pas g.yon dang / gnyis kas g.yas su bskor la me dang chur dor bar bsam/ de bzhin du oṃ hūm̐ ḍa ḍi ta phaṭ/ ces brjod la bskor zhing bya ba ste gnyis ka'ang lan gsum byas nas me chur bcug ste dor bar bsams la/ bdag gi byur dang skal ba ngan pa dang bkra mi shis pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig ces brjod/ dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyis bdag la bkra shis mdzad par bsams la/ dril bu gsil zhing me tog gtor/ sgrub grogs kyi rnam rgyal bum pa btegs la/ phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa'i tshigs bcad gsum mam/ spro na mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bkra shis kyang bya bar gsungs pas logs nas 'byung ba ltar byas la/ mthar/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig

ces brjod/ dbang dngos la gnyis las/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs dang / bdag gi rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang / dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad rdo rje dang / g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma ki sngon mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma zhes pa nas thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mi bskyod pa kyai rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa lan gnyis sam/ spro na so so'i sngags rgyas bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu dang bcas pa rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa zhes sogs gsungs shing /

de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa dang bcas te dbang bskur bas/ dbang gi chu rgyun des smin mtshams yan chad gang bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang gsang ba'i dbang thob/ snying kha yan chad gang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams cad gang mchog tu bde ba chen po bzhi pa'i dbang thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ de la oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa nas/ nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod/ de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i mngon par dbang bskur ba thob/ zhes pa nas/ mi bskyod pa'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag zhes pa'i bar lam dus bzhin brjod/ dbang lha spyan drangs pa dang mi bskyod pa'i khyad chos rnams dor ba ma gtogs/ 'og ma rnams la'ang 'di'i rigs 'gres sbyar te shes par bya'o/ /oṃ swa bhā wa/ bdag gi tshor ba'i phung po dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ aṃ las rin po che aṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan kyai rdo rje sku mdog ser po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad rin po che dang / g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu zhes sogs nas/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan kyai rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par/ gong ltar spyan drangs te so so la bstim/

'di man chad la cho ga zor yang ba'i phyir/ dbang lha spyan 'dren gong gi de nyid las mi mdzad pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab la/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa sogs kyis dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dbu rgyan du gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni zhes sogs kyi mthar/ rin chen dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na mu ku ṭa zhes sogs kyi dbu rgyan bcings te dbang bskur bar bsam/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa zhes sogs gsungs shing bum pa'i chu'i dbang bskur/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ puṣ+pe sogs lngas mchod/ de ltar na rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas cod paṇa gyi dbang thob/ ces pa nas rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag ces pa'i bar brjod/ swa bhā wa sogs/ bdag gi 'du shes kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ dz+riṃ las pad+ma dz+riṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gnyis ka'ang 'od dpag med kyai rdo rje sku mdog dmar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad pad+ma dang / g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug zhes sogs nas/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'od dpag med kyai rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sogs/ gong ltar spyan drangs la bstim/

de bzhin gshegs pa sogs 'dra/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi 'od dpag med yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring zhes sogs nas/ rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis longs/ /zhes pas lag pa g.yas su rdo rje byin par bsam/ badz+ri bha wa sogs kyis chu dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs lngas mchod/ de ltar na 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob/ ces sogs nas/ 'od dpag med kyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag ces pa'i bar brjod/ swa bhā wa sogs/ bdag gi 'du byed kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du kham̐ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gnyis ka'ang don yod grub pa kyai rdo rje sku mdog ljang khu zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad ral gri dang / g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug zhes sogs nas/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ don yod grub pa kyai rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs te so so la bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs 'dra/ badz+ri bhā was/ dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/

dbang rdzas kyi don yod grub pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ/ zhes sogs kyis dril bu lag pa g.yon par byin par bsams te/ badz+ri bha wa sogs kyis chu dbang bskur/ don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs lngas mchod/ de ltar na don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob/ ces sogs nas/ don yod grub pa'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag ces pa'i bar brjod/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ bdag gi gzugs kyi phung po mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ bh+rum̐ las 'khor lo bh+ruṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad kyai rdo rje sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad 'khor lo dang / g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs nas/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rnam par snang mdzad kyai rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥspyan drangs te bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang bskur bar bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa satwaṃ zhes sogs kyi mthar rang gi gsang mtshan nas brjod de che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes brjod cing rdo rje dril bu lhan cig spyi bor dkrol la chu'i dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs lngas mchod/

de ltar na rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas ming gi dbang thob/ ces pa nas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes brjod/ rigs lnga po de dag gi phyag mtshan rnams rdo rje gur nas 'byung ba ltar gsal btab kyang rung ngo / /de nas/ dngos kun gang dang gang snang ba/ /zhes sogs brjod de/ chos can gyi snang ba gang dang gang snang ba thams cad tha mal pa ma yin pa lhag pa'i lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin yin no snyam du bsam/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ bdag gi phung po lnga'i chos nyid de bzhin nyid mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag mtshan mi bskyod pa bzhin bskyed/ yum rdo rje snye ma dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs nas/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs la bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa sogs kyis chu dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ de nas hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje lha nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /zhes sogs sngags dang bcas pas lag pa g.yas par byin par bsams la/ gsor te snying khar bzung nas/ deng phyin chad tha mal pa'i spyod pa thul la/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin la bzhugs par gyis shig ces gsungs par bsam/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul la/

mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba/ /zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ rang nyid dbang stegs kyi steng du rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam pas 'khod par bsams la/ 'di de sogs sngags dang bcas pas g.yas su rdo rje byin pa snying khar bzung ste/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /zhes sogs brjod de/ rdo rje 'di ni chos kyi dbyings spros pa thams cad dang bral ba rig stong dbyer med kyi ngo bo mtshon par byed pa yin la/ rang gi sems thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nges don gyi rdo rje yin no snyam du bsam/ de nas a las byung ba'i dril bu lha nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /zhes sogs kyi lag pa g.yon du byin pa dkrol te/ dku g.yon par kha gyen du phyogs pas bzung la/ a srid pa ngo bo nyid kyi dag /ces sogs brjod de/ dril bu 'di ni chos kyi dbyings spros pa thams cad dang bral ba/ skye 'gag gnas gsum gyi stong pa mtshon par byed pa yin la/ rang gi ngag srid pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa ston par byed pa'i nges don gyi dril bu yin no snyam du bsam/ de nas rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' bshad ma thag pa ltar ram/ phyag gnyis pa gang rung du bsgom nas/ yan lag bzhi rdzogs mi byed par/ /shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /zhes sogs rim bzhin brjod pa tsam yang rung la/ phyag len la/ rang nyid rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo/ gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i mig tu zhes sogs nas/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje 'chang yab yum gyi rnam par rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs la bstim/

shes rab bcu drug sogs dang / rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zhes sogs brjod/ lag pa gnyis snying khar bsnol la/ srid pa'i bde ba sogs brjod de tha mal pa'i bde ba ni ma dag pa'o/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal zad par bya ba'i phyir rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor bya ste/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la longs spyod cig 'dis rdo rje 'chang chen po kha sbyor gyi sku thob pa las mi 'da' 'o/ /de bas na ting nge 'dzin 'di la gnas par gyis shig ces gsungs par bsam la/ de brtan pa'i ched du nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs dang ye shes kyi chus gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur bar bsams la/ rnam rgyal bum pa thogs te/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /zhes sogs nas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag ces pa'i bar mi bskyod pa chu dbang gi skabs ltar brjod la/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbur brgyan par bsams la/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor te rab gnas byas la/ puṣ+pe sogs lngas mchod de rdo rje dril bu dang dbu rgyan sogs bzhag la/ de ltar na khyod la rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbang bskur ba 'dis/ khyod kyi phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched kyi dri ma thams cad dag par byas pa yin pas/ de thams cad rang gi sems su 'du la/ sems de nyid mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin/ rdo rje sems dpa' yin pas rang gi sems rnam par dag pa nyid dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yin te/ dkyil 'khor zhes ni gang bshad pa/ /yid kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa nyid/ /gzhal med khang zhes bshad pa ni/ /sems kyi gzhal med khang brtsegs nyid/ /de yi phyi rol gru bzhi ni/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /gang gi byams pa la sogs sems/ /thig skud bzhir ni bshad pa'o/

/rdo rje'i thig tu gang bshad pa/ /chos ni rjes su dran pa'o/ /lta ba kun las rnam grol ba/ /ye shes thig tu bshad pa yin/ /rgyan gang yang dag bshad pa ni/ /tshul khrims sogs kyi sdom pa 'o/ /dbang po lnga sogs sems gang yin/ /rwa ba lngar ni 'byung ba nyid/ /gang zhig sgo zhes bshad pa ni/ /rnam par thar pa rnam pa bzhi/ /rta babs ka ba bzhi po ni/ /yang dag spong ba bzhi zhes brjod/ /dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi po ni/ /kha khyer bzhir ni brjod pa nyid/ /sgo khyud bzhi ni gang yin pa/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa rnam pa bzhi/ /de bzhin me tog phreng rgyan pa/ /byang chub yan lag bdun po yin/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad po ni/ /ka ba brgyad po zhes brjod do/ /lam gyi ye shes khyad par ni/ /rnga yab tu ni rab tu grags/ /gang zhig do shal bshad pa ni/ /nyon mongs thams cad gcod pa ste/ /kun tu gcod pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /nyon mongs 'phrog pa dra ba nyid/ /tshogs gnyis dag pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /'khor lo bskor ba gang yin pa/ /nyon mongs phyed ni gcod pas na/ /do shal phyed pa nyid du brjod/ /de bas na sems nyid ni byang phyogs so bdun gyi ngo bo gzhal yas khang pa yin la/ sems la phung po dang / khams dang skye mched la sogs pa du mar snang ba ni gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha yin te/ de yang phung po lnga ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdan/ 'byung ba bzhi ni rig ma'i gdan/ nang gi skyed mched ni byang chub sems dpa'i gdan/ phyi'i skye mched ni lha mo'i gdan/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa la sogs pa zad par byed pa ni khro bo dang khro mo'i gdan yin no/ /zhes brjod/ lha mchod pa'i rjes gnang ni/ gar skor sngon du 'gro bas/ khu tshur gnyis dku g.yas g.yon du bzhag ste/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sras dang bcas la rnam rol zhing / /rdo rje snyems ma'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /dga' ston bde ba'i mchod par gyis/ /a/ de bzhin du khu tshur gnyis kha 'gram g.yas g.yon du bzhag ste/

sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba 'phang / /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /des ni bcom ldan 'bral mi 'gyur/ /phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ /oṃ/ khu tshur gnyis kha nas 'byin pa ltar byas te/ lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ /glu ni khyod kyis blang bar bya/ /de yi bde gshegs dngos grub ni/ /myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ /gī/ rdo rje thal mo spyi bor bskor bas gar byas te/ de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /sangs rgyas 'du ba'i 'phrin las kyis/ /gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar bgyis/ /hoḥ khu tshur bdug spos kyi phyag rgya dang / rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis/ /hūm̐/ me tog gi phyag rgya dang / sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pas/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi/ /bde gshegs sku ni thob par gyis/ /bh+rum̐/ mar me'i phyag rgya dang / chos kyi me ni legs sbar bas/ /rdo rje chos dang 'dra ba ru/ /sems can ma rig ldongs pa la/ /ye shes sgron mes gsal bar gyis/ /pra/ g.yon pas dung chos 'dzin cing / g.yas pas dri bzang byugs pa'i tshul dang / rgyal ba rnams la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims shes rab ting 'dzin dang / /rnam grol ye shes thob pa yi/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bgos/ /ga zhes brjod// ༈ //sems can gyi don bya ba'i rjes gnang ni/ rtsa ba'i sngags kyis mngon par bsngags pa'i thur ma'am/ med na/ rdo rjes mig 'byed pa'i tshul bya zhing / ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yi/ /'jig rten ling thog bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ /ling thog rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa tra lam̐ hri praṃ/ zhes brjod/ me long len pa'i tshul bya zhing / /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/

/gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ /zhes brjod/ a las skyes pa'i dril bu blangs te/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /zhes brjod cing dkrol/ hoḥ zhes pas mda' gzhu byin pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags par byos shig ces gsungs par bsams la/ phyogs bzhi dang steng 'og gnyis su mda' 'phen tshul bya'o/ /me long rdo rje dang bcas pa len tshul byas la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long ltar/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gtso/ /gang yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub kyi sems ni 'di yin par shes par gyis shig ces brjod// ༈ //chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang ni/ oṃ badz+ra he tu mam̐/ zhes pas rkang pa'i 'og tu 'khor lo/ oṃ badz+ra bha ṣa ram̐/ zhes pas lag pa g.yas su dung / oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe a/ zhes pas g.yon du dril bu/ a/ zhes pas lag ngar gyi steng du po ti rnams byin par bsams la/ deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ /sngags spyad tshul gyis cho ga yis/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / /khyod la rtag tu srung ba mdzad/ /ces brjod/ gar skor sngon du 'gro bas/ rigs lnga so so'i phyag chen rnams rim pa bzhin du bcas la/

sems can kun la thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes pa'i tshe rnam snang dang / de bzhin du tshig rkang dang po gsum 'dra ba las/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes dang mi bskyod pa/ rin chen 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes dang rin 'byung / pad+ma'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes dang 'od dpag med/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes dang don grub kyi phyag rgya byas la/ de ltar na/ khyod kyi sems can thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo/ rin chen 'khor lo/ pad+ma'i 'khor lo/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rnams bskor la/ sems can thams cad la chos kyi dung bus/ sgra sgrogs bshad par gyis shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam/ de ltar na bskyed pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor ram ras bris gang yin pa skabs dang sbyar la/ dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ gtso bo lus kyi dri ma dag dam tshig gi rtsa ba yan lag gi dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsrung ba la dbang bar byas/ brda lnga bsdus rtse mo mnan pa dang / lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kyai/ /zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras bcings la/ bla ma he ru ka yab yum snyoms par bzhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs te/ yab kyi zhal du bzhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ byang chub kyi sems rdo rje nor bu'i lam nas yum gyi khar bab pa'i thig le mu tig gi rdog ma lta bu bdag gi lce thog tu bzhag par bsams shing / dngos su bdud rtsi myangs la/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/

/zhes sogs brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ zhes brjod cing myangs pas/ mgrin pa nas thig le 'phel te lus thams cad gang bas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa thams cad 'gags te gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin brgyud la skyes par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas bsrungs te mig ras phye bar bsam/ de nas bla ma shākya thub pa'i rnam par 'phos nas chos gos kyi grwa ri dwags kyi rna ba lta bu dang / g.yas pas rdor dril 'dzin pa'i skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas rang gi gsang mtshan nas lung ston par bsams la/ dngos su rang gis de ltar byas te/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las ston/ /kyai dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa sa 'og sa steng / sa bla rnams su bhur bhu ba swa/ gang la ngas lung bstan pa 'di la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu lung ston par mdzad de/ sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no/ /zhes brjod/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag dam tshig sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu bstan pa la dbang bar byas/ brda mtheb srin e la rig byed gcig lam bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ bstod pa dang gsol btab gong ltar byas te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras bcings/ bla mas mtshan nyid ldan pa'i phyag rgya ma zhig bdag la gtad par bsams te/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni/ /sna tshogs sogs brjod/ phyag rgya ma des/ bshang gci dag ni za ba dang / /khrag dang zhes pa nas/

bu khyod ci dgar spro gyur tam/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis dri ba byas par bsam/ bdag gis kyang / bshang gci dag ni zhes pa nas/ /bdag nyid ci dgar spro gyur to/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis lan btab pas phyag rgya de dges nas lus gcer bur phyung / chu skyes gur gum la sogs pas dri zhim par byas/ rtsa mchog tu rgyas pa'i pad+ma ston bzhin du/ e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di/ /zhes sogs kyi mjug tu/ satwaṃ pad+ma bhañja mok+ṣa hoḥ zhes gsungs shing rang gi pang du byon par bsam/ rang nyid kyai rdo rje dang / phyag rgya bdag med mar gsal ba lha'i 'du shes/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs sgrub thabs ltar dran pa sngags kyi 'du shes/ thabs 'di la rten nas lhan skyes sngon du bya'o snyam pa chos kyi 'du shes te rim pa bzhin du sprul longs chos gsum lam du byed thabs 'du shes gsum dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas snyoms par zhugs pas/ yas bab dang mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi'i rtogs pa skyes par mos la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras phye bar bsam// ༈ //de nas lam gyi dbugs dbyung rgyas pa ni/ slob dpon smad par mi bya zhing / /bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /spun la smod pa nyid mi bya/ /sems can rnams la gdug byams dang / /byang chub sems ni spang mi bya/ /bdag gzhan chos la smad mi bya/ /skal med de nyid gtam mi bya/ /bdag gi lus la nges mi smad/ /chos la yid gnyis spang bya zhing / /gdug la byams pa nyid mi bya/ /chos nyid tshad ni gzung mi bya/ /skal ldan sems can spang mi bya/ /dam tshig rtag tu bskyang bar bya/ /bud med nyid la smad mi bya/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /dkon mchog gsum ni spang mi bya/ /rtag tu dam tshig bsrung bar bya/ /rdo rje dril bu gzung bar bya/ /gtsug tor rtag tu bcang par bya/ /rtag tu sbyin sreg dgang bar bya/ /rtag tu dkyil 'khor bzhengs par bya/ /rtag tu bde gshegs rab gnas bya/

/'byung po che la gtor ma sbyin/ /phyag rgya bcing ba rnam spang zhing / /mchod rten las ni mi bya ste/ /rdo rje gsum mchog phyag mi bya/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs lus kyi las/ /rmi lam du yang mi bya 'o/ /slob dpon gzhan la phyag mi bya/ /bla ma'i rgan rab phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag par rgyun du sngags bzla zhing / /bsam gtan nyid kyang rnam par spyad/ /rtag tu slob ma bsdu bya zhing / /rtag par ru ni bshad par bgyi/ /rtag tu sems can bskyangs bar bya/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas cher mnyes bya/ /dzam+bha la la chu sbyin zhing / /las rnams thams cad yang dag spyad/ /bye ma'i las la mchod rten yang / /mkhas pas cho ga bzhin du bya/ /zhes brjod/ don yid la dran par bya'o/ /'bras bu'i dbugs dbyung ba ni/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ /khams gsum na ni sdig med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral bar/ /khyod kyis nam yang mi bya 'o/ /mahā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes pa ste/ de'i don ni/ dad pa chen pos lha dang bla ma la chags pa dang / snying rje chen pos sems can gyi don la chags pa/ shes rab chen pos chos kyi de kho na nyid la chags pa zhes bya ba 'di gsum dang bral na sdig che ba yin pas/ de gsum dang ma bral ba la bslab par bya'o/ /de nas rang nyid kyis dkyil 'khor la brkyang phyag gsum byas pa'i tha ma la dkyil 'khor pa rnams la lus phul bar bsams la/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin 'gyur ba'i/ /slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags/ /zhes phul bas/ de rnams kyis 'bras bu'i dbugs phyung bar bsams te/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bris/ /khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas su/ /sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya/

/khams gsum na ni rgyal srid che/ /dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bdud tshogs kun las nges rgyal te/ /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin/ /zhes brjod/ de ltar na phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag dam tshig bud med la mi smod pa la dbang / brda byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya/ lam dkyil 'khor bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu chos sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/ /dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras bcing / ye shes 'di ni sogs brjod la/ /lus bsam gtan gyi chos dang ldan par byas/ ngag rlung rgyu ba sor bzhag sems dus gsum gyi rtog pa'i rgyu 'phrul gzhan thams cad bcad la/ brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang gi sems su nges pa'i shes pa bskyed de/ sems kyi mtshan nyid gsal ba/ rang bzhin stong pa/ ngo bo zung 'jug gsum dbyer mi phyed par rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa'i sku bzhi rang chas su gnas pa de nyid/ 'bras dus kyi sku bzhi dang ngo bo dbyer med du ngo shes bskyed de/ de mngon du byed pa'i thabs gzhan gyi tshig tu brjod pa la sogs pas rtogs pa mi nus pas/ dpe dbang gsum pa'i ye shes kyi steng du ngo sprad de rtogs pa bya ba ni/ rang nyid dbang gsum pa'i gnas skabs su lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam pa snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i sku can du snang ba sprul pa'i sku dang / de'i sems rgyud phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba las byung ba'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rnam par shar ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / lha sku bde ba chen po'i rnam par snang tsam de nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum thams cad dang bral ba chos kyi sku dang / de gsum ldog tshul tha dad kyang rang bzhin so sor dbyer mi phyed pa ni ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/

mdor na sems kyi gshis cir yang ma yin pa/ mdangs bde chen du ma 'gags pa/ rtsal sna tshogs su 'char ba/ sgom bya sgom byed thams cad las 'das pa nam mkha' lta bur shes par byas la/ nam mkha' dang nam mkha' ro gcig pa ltar/ sems dang bde stong ro gcig pa'i ngang la 'dzin med du khong lhod kyis glod la mnyam par bzhag pa'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras phye la/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /btsud pa dang ni mthong ba yis/ /de ring sdig las rnam grol 'gyur/ /de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba yod ma yin/ /mi thub pa dang mi 'chi bas/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /zhes brjod de/ don yid la dran bzhin pas sgo nas gzengs bstod do/ /de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag dam tshig dgongs te gsungs pa'i dam tshig bsrung ba la dbang / brda mdzub mo'i nam mkha' mtshon pa/ lam rdo rje rba rlabs bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed la/ gnas skabs de dag tu thob pa'i dam tshig la bsrung sdom bgyid snyam pas/ gtso bo'i ji ltar sogs lan gsum dang / dbang yongs su rdzogs pa'i btang rag tu maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa phul te/ lus dang longs spyod thams cad kyang 'bul cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas/ deng nas brtsams te zhes sogs lan gsum brjod/ de nas dam tshig gsum gyi glu blang ba ni/ gang du dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / gang gis bskur ba'i slob dpon dang / /gang la bskur ba'i slob ma ste/ /'khor gsum ka snang la rang bzhin med pa/ skye med bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin las ma 'das pa yin pas/ de'i mthus bdag gis kyang de ltar rtogs par gyur cig snyam pas tshigs bcad re re'i mtshams su rdo rje gsor/

dril bu bcad gtubs su dkrol te/ oṃ nam mkha' skye ba mtshon ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /kye yi rdo rje bdag grub mdzod/ /kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag sgrub mdzod/ /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa ste/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes su chags/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid kyis grub mdzod/ /shin tu dam pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems su bdag sgrub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya'i mchog /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje snyems bdag bdag sgrub mdzod/ /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ /sems can kun gyi yid la zhugs/ /sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid/ /'dod chags mnyam pa'i dam tshig mchog /ces lan gcig dang / dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du snang ba yang chos sku stong pa dang snying rje gnyis su med pa las byung ba'i byin rlabs dang / slob dpon gyis kyang de ltar rtogs pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ slob ma rnams kyis kyang rdul tshon nam/ mtshan ma la sogs pa tsam ma yin par snang la rang bzhin med pa gzugs kyi skur mthong ba gyur cig snyam pas/ shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa'i byin brlabs gang yin pa/ /bden pa 'di yis mgon bdag la/ /khyod kyi 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzad/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu byung / /de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung / /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis sgrib med mthong bar shog
