/ces bden stobs brjod/ skabs 'dir gtor ma rnams nang mchod chu chang gis bran la/ sngar sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar gyi cho gas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma rnams dbul lo/ /brgyad pa mjug gi cho ga ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs te/ phyi nang yid byung bstod pa rnams bya/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ ras bris yin na/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i zhes sogs kyi mthar/ khyad par du yang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brten par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes sogs dang / rdul tshon gyi phyogs yin na/ gshegs gsol gyi nyin ma gtogs pa'i nyi ma snga ma rnams la gong gi khyad par du yang / zhes pa'i rjes su/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas kyi bar du zhes sogs brjod la/ rten med pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol ba dang / dam tshig pa bsdu ba sogs sta gon gyi skabs ltar bya'o/ /rdul tshon gshegs gsol gyi nyin rjes chog gi tshe/ bum pa rnams khyams kyi steng du bzhag la/ cho ga gzhan rnams snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyi rjes su/ bdag las dang po ba'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs byas la/ rten la ma brten pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams dang / rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa dang / bum nang gi ye shes pa rnams chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ de nas rol mo dang bcas pas/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma naṃ a d+ya nut+pan na twata ces dang /

oṃ khyed kyi sogs kyi mthar/ mtheb srin gyi se gol byas te/ badz+ra muḥzhes dang / oṃ gi li gi li hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes brjod cing de kho na nyid dran pas rdo rje'i rtses dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa dang por gshegs/ lha'i mtshan ma rnams nas rdul tshon mtheb srin gyis blangs la rang gi spyi bor gzhag de nas g.yas bskor gyis rim pas ci bde bar gshegs su gsol/ rdul tshon 'dod pa yod na lha'i mtshan ma nas blangs la byin/ gzhan rnams mtha' nas rim pas bsdus te/ za ma tog la sogs par blugs la/ rdul tshon chu bor spyan drangs pa'i cho ga'am/ de tsam ma nus na bkur bsti chen pos rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu rlung ngam/ khron pa la sogs par gshegs su gsol la/ thig rjes rnams dri zhim po'i chus mtha' nas rim pa bzhin phyis te/ rjes mi mngon par byas la/ grub na skabs 'dir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ phyogs kun tu me tog gi gsil ma gtor te/ smon lam dang bkra shis bya ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /lus can kun gyi bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /myur du 'grub nas tshe 'di kho na la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god par shog /bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /bla med theg pa chen po'i snod gyur nas/ /kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /bdag kyang sangs rgyas ma thob bar/ /skye dang skye bar gnas bzang po/ /rigs bzang spyod pa bzang ba dang / /grogs bzang bla mas rjes 'dzin shog /tshul khrims dag cing mkhas la bsgrin/ /rnam par dag cing rgyud gcig la/ /bskal bzang spyod pas rnam brgyan te/ /thos nas legs bshad ston par shog /mgo bor bla ma'i cod paṇa bcings/ /lag pas thabs shes rdor dril 'dzin/ /ngag tu gsang sngags rgyal po bzla/ /yid kyis zung 'jug bsgom par shog /'di nas byang chub ma thob par/ /bla ma lha dang mi 'bral zhing /

/sgrub la bar chad med pa dang / /bstan la bya ba byed par shog /bla med bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang / /dgra bcom bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /ji ltar bsngos bzhin 'grub par shog /ces pa'i smon lam dang // ༈ //bkra shis ni/ mtshungs med bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /mthu stobs dbang phyug bla ma brgyud par bcas/ /mtshan nas brjod dam cung zad dran yang rung / /bkra shis 'phel zhing skye dgu bde legs shog /pad+ma'i lte bar bdud bzhi'i steng na brjid/ /yon tan mtha' yas ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /he ru ka dpal bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ /bkra shis 'phel zhing skye dgu bde legs shog /sna tshogs pad+ma'i 'dab mar bde bar bzhugs/ /skye mched 'byung ba rnam par dag pa'i dngos/ /ye shes tshad med rang bzhin lha mo brgyad/ /bkra shis 'phel zhing skye dgu bde legs shog /khams drug dag pa ye shes chen po'i sku/ /lam gyi yan lag sum cu rtsa bdun te/ /snang ba sangs rgyas zhing gyur gzhal med khang / /bkra shis 'phel zhing skye dgu bde legs shog /yan lag rnam dag khro bo chen po'i sku/ /rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba bla bre gur/ /bdud dpung nges 'joms bsrung ba'i 'khor lo mchog /bkra shis 'phel zhing skye dgu bde legs shog /dag bya dag byed nang ngam phyi na bzhugs/ /phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu dang sprin dang shing / /mchod rten ro dang 'dre dang me dang chu/ /phyogs brgyad dag byed des ni bkra shis shog /bla ma dkyil 'khor gtso bo 'khor dang bcas/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed lam dang 'bras bu mchog /brjod dam de don cung zad dran yang rung / /bkra shis 'phel zhing skye dgu bde legs shog /ces sogs kyi bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs dang / rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs dang / tshogs kyi 'khor lo'am dpa' bo'i ston mo la sogs pa dga' ston rgya chen po byas nas chos dang mthun pa'i spyod pas gnas par bya'o/

/gong du bshad pa'i sta gon dang dngos gzhi'i mdun bskyed kyi mchod bstod kyi skabs su dgos pas deng sang bstod pa rgyas pa phyag len la mdzad pa'i/ bstod pa nyi shu pa ni 'di yin te/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /kyai rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /bdag med ma yis mgul nas 'khyud/ /dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes/ /zhal brgyad pa la spyan gsum pa/ /mgon po de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /spyi bo'i gdeng steng nag po mdzes/ /dkar dang dmar po g.yas dang g.yon/ /gang gi lhag ma'i zhal rnams ni/ /gnag pa de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /glang po rta bong glang rnga mo/ /mi dang sha ra bha byi la/ /g.yas pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /zla nyi gshin rje gsang ba pa/ /g.yon pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhabs bzhi pos ni bdud bzhi po/ /mnyam par mnan cing gcer bu nyid/ /nyi mar zhabs g.yas brkyang dang sngo/ /gar mdzad de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /'khor lo bzhi yis bdag nyid mdzes/ /'dzag pa'i mgo bos rnam par brgyan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam dag pa'i/ /phyag rgya lngas ni rnam par brgyan/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes dbu steng mdzes/ /spyi bor rigs kyi bdag po nyid/ /dam pa'i dga' ba yang dag thob/ /bde chen de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gam̐ las skyes pa'i gau rī shar/ /yan lag gnag cing g.yon na nya/ /g.yas pa na ni gri gug 'dzin/ /tshangs pa mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /tsam̐ las byung ba'i chom rkun ma/ /btsod kyi kha dog lho phyogs su/ /phyag na phag dang cang te'u bsnams/ /dbang po mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /bam̐ las skyes pa'i ser mo nub/ /ro langs ma ni nye dbang mnan/ /g.yon na lhung bzed g.yas pa na/ /rus sbal 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /ghasma rī ni byang gi sgor/ /ljang khu ghaṃ las byung ba yi/

/phyag gnyis sbrul dang thod pas 'brel/ /drag po mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gshin rje mnan cing pam̐ las byung / /g.yon na dgra satwa seṅge g.yas/ /dbang ldan du ni 'jigs gzugs ma/ /phyag 'tshal puk+ka sī sngo la'o/ /ri khrod ma dkar sham̐ las byung / /me ru nor sbyin steng na gnas/ /g.yon na gsil byed g.yas pa na/ dge slong 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gtum mo nam mkha'i sngo bsangs ma/ /srin po lam̐ las byung ba yi/ /g.yon na thod pa 'khor lo g.yas/ /phyag 'tshal srin po nyid la 'o/ /ḍam̐ las skyes pa'i g.yung mo ni/ /rlung mtshams thags zangs ris steng gshegs/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub g.yas rdo rje/ /sna tshogs mdog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas/ /phyag rgya lngas ni rnam par brgyan/ /gcer bu spyan gsum thams cad la/ /bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phung po khams ni rnam dag pa'i/ /byang chub sems las byung ba yi/ /bde rab ster 'di thams cad la/ /dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid kyi g.yas pa'i phyag bzung ba'i/ /phyag mtshan sa bon las byung ba/ /bde chen 'dod pa thams cad la/ /rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig nyi zla kha sbyor gnas sa bon/ /gnyis las skyes pa'i gtso bo rig mar bcas/ /nyid kyis nyid kyi dkyil 'khor 'di las ni/ /'jig rten gsum po sprul par mdzad dang ldan/ /nyid kyi 'di dag thams cad ma lus pa/ /zhi ba'i bde gtso rig ma bsdu mdzad pa/ /shes rab chags pas bdud rtsi ro nyid kyi/ /gnas su zhi ba de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gro ma gtso kyai rdo rje/ /lha mo 'khor lo bcas bstod pas/ /bdag gi bsod nams gang thob pa/ /des ni 'jig rten de mtshungs shog /ces slob dpon mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa dang / yang rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa 'di yang mdzad de/ bdag gi spyi bor thal sbyar nas/ /dang bas bla ma la btud nas/ /dpal ldan kyai rdo rje la/ /sdebs sbyor daṇ+ḍa kas bstod pa/

/pad nyid dang ni sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ yig las byung rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba dra ba gur dang bla bre 'bar ba'i me'i nang du phyogs bdag zhing skyong lto 'phye'i dbang po mchod rten chu dang me dang shing dang chu 'dzin dang ni 'dre dang srin po mkha' 'gro dang ni mkha' 'gro ma dang ro langs ro dang ro ni mdung gis phug dang dum bu dang ni tshil dang klad pa ser skya lug cing khrag dang skra'i dum dang de dag 'thor dang rus pas gang zhing rkang rus gar byed ce spyang phaiṃ zhes sgrog cing bya yi tshogs kyis gang ba'i khrod na rnal 'byor ma dang rnal 'byor dbang phyug sogs kyi dbus su chos kyi 'byung gnas dmar skya'i mdog can gdengs ka gyen du phyogs pa'i nang na thar pa chen po'i grong khyer ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin rin chen las grub gru bzhi dang ni sgo bzhis mdzes shing rin chen ka ba rdo rje'i gdung dang rta babs dang bcas ri dwags chos kyi 'khor lo gdugs dang bcas shing pha gu mda' yab rin chen du ma'i dra ba dang ni dra phyed zla ba rlung gis bskyod dang me tog 'phreng dang dril bu dang ni g.yar kha'i 'phreng dang rgyal mtshan che dang ba dan mdzes bcas rnga yab dar gyi lda ldis brgyan cing mchod snam steng na lha mo'i tshogs rnams mchod rdzas du mas lag 'brel mdzes pa'i rgyan can 'dzum pa'i bzhin dang glu yi dbyangs ldan zur mig blta dang bcas pas gang zhing pho brang rtse mor rdo rje dang ni nor bu'i rtog can rin chen las grub ches mtho mdzes pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar gdong bzhi dang ni dbang po dang bcas 'jug sel dag dang drag po rnams ni rtabs shing 'gyel la lag cha shor nas thal mo sbyar zhing gdong gi gyen du blta ba rnams kyi snying kha'i steng du tsha zer can gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan rab rgyas srid zhi mnyam par 'joms pa de ni chos nyid rang bzhin nam mkha'i mdog dang cung zad char sprin mdog la ut+pal sngo dang baiḍūr+ya ltar sngo la rnam thar rang bzhin zhal brgyad pa ste g.yas ni chu shel mdog la pad+ma rā ga'i mdog tu g.yon pa snang zhing lhag ma rnams ni du ba'i mdog la ral pa dmar ser gyen du langs shing zhal rnams re re spyan gsum dmar la zla phyed 'dra ba'i mche ba'i bdud rnams skrag mdzad stong nyid ngo bo drug lhag bcu yi phyag na btung ba'i snod mchog zla ba rgyas pa zil non lta bur dkar ba'i nang na gnyis 'thung myur 'gro sgra can khyu mchog mgrin ring mi dang ri dwags rgyal po byi la rnams ni g.yas yin gcig shos rnams na gzhi dang rlan byed gnas med drod dang ri bong can dang nyin mor byed dang mthar byed dang ni nor gyi bdag po 'dzin cing bsdu dngos rang bzhin zhabs bzhi'i gar gyi brjid kyis sa gzhi grum nas bying ba'i stobs kyis rgya mtsho 'khrugs nas gyen du bskyod pa'i rba rlabs mthor zhing srid pa gsum po g.yo bar mdzad pa'i rang bzhin can la thal chen gyis byugs sku de'i rgyan na kha ba dung dang ku mu ta ltar dkar ba'i mi rus phreng dang mi mgo'i cod paṇa khrag 'dzag mgo phreng do shal bcas shing rgyu ma'i lda ldis brgyan la sna tshogs rdo rjes dbu steng mdzes shing dril bu dang ni dril bu g.yer kha rin chen mchog dang dug sprul gdengs ka dang bcas 'jigs pa'i ce spyang drag po'i phud sgra dang bcas la sogs du mas brgyan byas stag lpags dang ni mi yi pags pas rnam dkris ha ha hi hi la sogs 'jigs pa'i bzhed sgra drag pos dregs pa can rnams btul zhing brlag par mdzad nas slar yang gso bar mdzad la nyams dgu dang ni ldan pa'i bcom ldan bde ba chen po'i ye shes ngo bo nyid la dbyings kyi rang bzhin rdo rje bdag med ma dpal dag dang gnyis min gnyis ni spangs shing gnyis med ngo bo gang yin de ni lha mo'i tshogs kyi dbus na bzhugs shing 'gro ba ma lus pa rnams srid pa'i 'jigs dang mya ngan 'das pa'i 'jigs pa rnams las skyob par mdzad pa'i he ru ka dpal mgon po du mar snang zhing rang bzhin gnyis med de yi zhabs la bdag ni rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/

/gang zhig he ru ka yi bstod pa'i rgyal po 'di/ /'gro ba gang zhig 'dzin nam bstod par byed kyang rung / /nyan nam cung zhig sems par byed pa de dag ni/ /gsang ba gsum bdag he ru ka dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /dus dgra'i rdo rje sems dpa' la/ /rgyun chags zhes bya'i sdeb sbyor du/ /bsdebs pa'i bstod pa'i rgyal po 'di/ /grags pa rgyal mtshan bdag gis bgyis/ /'di bgyis pa las ngal bar gyur pa yi/ /dge ba dri ma gangs ri ltar dkar ba/ /bdag gi rgyud la skyes pa de dag gis/ /'gro kun dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin 'gyur shog /ces rgyun chags shing 'gran zla med pa'i bstod pa zhes bya ba bstod pa dngos la yi ge bdun brgya bdun cu rtsa bdun bgyis so/ /shākya'i dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis nye bar sbyar ba 'di yongs su rdzogs pa'o// //de ltar dgyes pa rdo rje'i sgrub dkyil gyi/ /cho ga'i rnam gzhag gsal bar bkod pa 'di/ /mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog lhun grub kyi/ /gsung rab mdzes brgyan rnams kyi dgongs pa bzhin/ /sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras kyi/ /phyag len rnam par dag pas rab brgyan te/ /dang po'i las can 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir/ /lhag bsam rnam par dag pas kun blangs nas/ /sa skyar gnas pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams bdag gis sdebs/ /dge ba 'di tshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /'gro rnams sgrib gnyis ma lus kun byang nas/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /phyi ma kun kyang dag pa'i zhing bgrod shog /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //dpal kye rdo rje'i bstod pa nyi shu pa/ rgya gar skad du/ he badz+ra maṇ+ḍa la stot+t+ra nā ma/ bod skad du/ kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ dpal kye rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa/

/kye yi rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /bdag med ma yis mgul nas 'khyud/ /dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes/ /zhal brgyad pa ni spyan gsum pa/ /mgon po de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /spyi bo dang steng nag pos mdzes/ /dkar dang dmar po g.yas dang g.yon/ /gang gi lhag ma'i zhal rnams ni/ /nag pa de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /glang po rta bong glang rnga mo/ /skyes pa khyi dang ma he can/ /g.yas pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /zla nyi gshin rje gsang ba pa/ /g.yon pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhabs bzhi pos ni bdud bzhi po/ /mnyam par mnan cing gcer bu nyid/ /nyi mar zhabs g.yas brkyang dang sngo/ /gar mdzad de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /'khor lo bzhi yis bdag nyid 'jigs/ /'dzag pa'i mgo bos rnam par brgyan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam dag pa'i/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes spyi bor mtshan/ /dpral bar rigs kyi bdag po nyid/ /dam pa'i dga' ba yang dag thob/ /bde chen de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gam̐ las skyes pa'i gau rī shar/ /yan lag gnag cing g.yon na nya/ /g.yas pa na ni gri gug 'dzin/ /tshangs pa mnan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tsam̐ las skyes pa'i chom rkun ma/ /btsod kyi kha dog lho phyogs su/ /phyag na phag dang cang te'u bsnams/ /dang po mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /bam̐ las skyes pa'i ser mo nub/ /ro langs ma ni nye dbang mnan/ /phyag g.yon lhung bzed g.yas pa yi/ /phyag na rus sbal bdag phyag 'tshal/ /ghasma rī ni byang gi sgor/ /ljang gu gham̐ las byung ba yi/ /phyag na sbrul dang thod pas brel/ /drag po mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gshin rje mnan cing pam̐ las byung / /g.yon na dgra satwa seng ge g.yas/ /dbang ldan du ni 'jigs gzugs ma/ /phyag 'tshal puk+ka sī sngo la'o/ /ri khrod ma dkar sham̐ las byung / /me ru nor sbyin steng na gnas/ /g.yon na gsil byed g.yas pa na/

/dge slong 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gtum mo nam mkha'i sngo bsangs ma/ /srin por lam̐ las byung ba yi/ /g.yon na thong pa'i 'khor lo g.yas/ /phyag 'tshal srin po nyed pa la'o/ /ḍam̐ las skyes pa'i g.yung mo ni/ /rlung mtshams thags zangs ri steng gshegs/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub g.yas rdo rje/ /sna tshogs mdog la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs/ /phyag rgya lngas ni rnam par brgyan/ /gcer bu spyan gsum thams cad la/ /bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phung po khams ni rnam dag pa'i/ /byang chub sems las byung ba yi/ /bde rab ster 'di thams cad la/ /dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid kyi g.yas pa'i phyag bzung ba'i/ /phyag mtshan sa bon las byung ba/ /bde chen 'dod pa thams cad la/ /rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig nyi zla kha sbyor gnas sa bon/ /gnyis las skyes pa'i gtso bo rig mar bcas/ /nyid kyis nyid kyi dkyil 'khor 'di la ni/ /'jig rten gsum po sprul par mdzad dang ldan/ /nyid kyi 'di dag thams cad ma lus pa/ /zhi ba'i bde stsol rig ma sdud mdzad pa/ /shes rab chags pa bdud rtsi'i ro nyid kyi/ /gnas su nyi bde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gro ma gtso kyai rdo rje/ /lha mo'i 'khor lor bcas bstod pa'i/ /bdag gis bsod nams gang thob pa/ /des ni 'jig rten de mtshungs shog /kyai rdo rje'i bstod pa nyi shu pa slob dpon chen po pad+ma badz+ras mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgyu gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang bod kyi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur pa'o// ༈ //mi bskyod pa phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na/ glang po che/ rta/ bong bu/ glang / rnga mo/ mi/ sha ra bha/ byi la/ g.yon pa rnams na/ sa'i lha/ chu'i lha/ me'i lha/ rlung gi lha/ zla ba'i lha/ nyi ma'i lha/ gshin rje/ nor sbyin rnams 'dzin pa/ rtsa zhal gyi spyi bor rdo rje nag pos mtshan cing / ༈ /rin chen 'byung ldan phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na/
